items.title: New lower bounds for CDS and $f$-routing
items.summary: Understanding the entanglement cost of non-local quantum computation (NLQC) is relevant to complexity theory, cryptography, quantum gravity, and related areas. A central special case is $f$-routing, motivated in part by quantum position verification. Proving lower bounds on its entanglement cost in the fully robust setting has been a major open problem in NLQC. Motivated by this problem, we establish two related lower bounds. First, we study the shared-randomness cost of robust conditional disclosure of secrets (CDS). The connection between CDS and $f$-routing established by Allerstorfer et al. (Quantum 2024) makes understanding the randomness complexity of robust CDS a natural step toward lower bounds for the fully robust routing problem. We show that the shared-randomness cost of robust CDS is lower bounded by the logarithm of deterministic SMP communication complexity, even when communication and private randomness are unrestricted. Our lower bound is tight for the equality function. Second, we consider one-sided-perfect $f$-routing, in which the protocol is exact on one input class and has constant error on the other. By exploiting the positivity of the low-rank matrix arising in the method of Asadi, Culf, and May (ITCS 2025), we derive a general lower bound on the entanglement cost in terms of sign rank. In particular, this yields a linear lower bound on the entanglement cost of routing for the inner-product function in both one-sided-perfect settings, matching the known upper bound.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究非局域量子计算(NLQC)的纠缠代价问题。NLQC 的纠缠代价与复杂性理论、密码学、量子引力等方向相关, 其核心特例是 f-routing, 该问题部分源自量子位置验证(QPV)。在完全稳健(fully robust)设定下证明 f-routing 纠缠代价的下界, 是 NLQC 领域长期未解的公开问题, 本文针对该目标给出两项相关下界结果。第一, 研究稳健条件式秘密披露(CDS)的共享随机性代价。基于 Allerstorfer 等人(Quantum 2024)建立的 CDS 与 f-routing 之间的联系, 理解稳健 CDS 的随机性复杂度是通向完全稳健路由下界的自然一步。作者证明: 稳健 CDS 的共享随机性代价下界为确定性 SMP(同时消息传递)通信复杂度的对数, 即使通信量与私有随机性不受限制该结论仍成立; 对相等函数(equality), 该下界是紧的。第二, 考虑单侧完美(one-sided-perfect)的 f-routing, 即协议在一类输入上精确、在另一类输入上仅有常数误差。作者利用 Asadi、Culf 与 May(ITCS 2025)方法中出现的低秩矩阵的正性, 导出以符号秩(sign rank)表示的纠缠代价通用下界; 特别地, 对内部积(inner-product)函数, 在两种单侧完美设定下均得到线性纠缠代价下界, 并与已知上界相匹配。整体属于量子信息与理论计算机科学交叉的理论工作, 核心贡献是新下界工具与紧致性结果, 适合复杂性理论、量子密码与 QPV 方向研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: f-routing 是量子位置验证安全性论证的基础之一。本文推进了完全稳健纠缠代价下界这一长期公开问题, 提供 CDS 随机性下界与符号秩下界两类工具, 对依赖 NLQC/CDS 假设的量子密码协议安全模型具有潜在影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响量子位置验证及基于 NLQC/CDS 假设的量子密码协议的安全论证; 所引入的下界工具(确定性 SMP 通信复杂度对数、符号秩)可迁移到其他需要证明纠缠或随机性下界的量子密码任务。
defense_advice_zh: 在评估或设计量子位置验证类协议时, 不应把 f-routing 纠缠代价的现有假设当作唯一安全依据, 需待完全稳健设定下的下界结论成熟后再固化安全模型。

items.title: How It's Made: Uncovering Detection Engineering Processes for Network Intrusion Detection Rules
items.summary: Many Security Operations Centers rely on signature-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems like Suricata, yet detection rule engineering remains understudied. We investigate this process by introducing SuriCap, a platform for rule engineering exercises, and hosting CTF-style workshops where 60 participants, trained MSc students, and experienced SOC professionals, created rules for four scenarios. Participants produced 3146 valid rules, enabling analysis of their methods, performance, and iteration patterns. Surprisingly, prior experience had limited impact on rule quality, suggesting that less experienced engineers can produce rules comparable to experts. We also observed challenges in generalizing rules beyond available tests, underscoring the need for sufficient labeled data. From our study, we identify three phases and a common pattern in rule engineering, offering SOC managers insights to improve their processes and expectations of engineer expertise.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于安全运营中心（SOC）中广泛依赖的签名型网络入侵检测系统（如 Suricata）的检测规则工程化流程。尽管这类规则是 SOC 检测能力的核心，但规则编写者如何思考、迭代与评估规则的过程长期缺乏系统研究。作者为此设计了 SuriCap 平台，用于开展可控的规则工程实验，并组织了 CTF 式工作坊。共有 60 名参与者，包括受过训练的硕士研究生与具备实战经验的 SOC 专业人员，他们针对四个不同场景编写检测规则，最终产出 3146 条语法有效且可被系统加载的规则。基于这批数据，作者从编写方法、规则性能与迭代模式三个维度进行了量化与质性分析。一个反直觉的发现是：参与者的既往经验对规则质量的影响有限，经验较少的工程师也能写出与专家水平相当的规则，说明规则工程能力可能更多来自流程与方法训练，而非单纯的工作年限。另一个关键观察是规则泛化能力不足：当规则被应用到训练或开发时未覆盖的测试样本时，检测效果明显下降，作者据此指出充足且高质量的标注数据对规则工程至关重要。研究最终归纳出规则工程普遍经历的三个阶段以及一种常见迭代模式，为 SOC 管理者优化检测工程流程、合理设定对工程师专业能力的预期提供了实证依据。该工作适合检测工程、安全运营、威胁检测研究方向的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 规则工程是 SOC 检测能力的核心环节，但长期缺少实证研究。该工作用 60 人、3146 条规则的可控实验揭示了经验与规则质量关系有限、泛化困难等反直觉结论，能直接帮助 SOC 管理者调整招聘、培训与规则评审策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到使用 Suricata、Snort 等签名型 NIDS 的 SOC 检测工程流程：规则开发阶段划分、标注数据投入、泛化测试集建设、新手培养与专家预期管理。
detection_signals_zh: 规则在训练样本上表现良好但在新样本上检出率骤降，疑似过拟合测试样例
规则缺乏对流量变体、编码变形或协议扩展的覆盖，泛化能力不足
规则工程缺少明确的阶段划分与迭代记录，评审与复测环节缺失
defense_advice_zh: 将规则工程划分为明确阶段（如需求理解、规则编写、测试迭代），并在每个阶段设置质量门禁
投入构建充足、多样且标注准确的测试数据集，避免规则仅拟合有限样例
使用与开发样本分布不同的保留集评估规则泛化能力，作为上线前必检项
建立规则同行评审与迭代记录机制，避免依赖个别专家经验
对经验较少的工程师提供结构化流程与工具支持，而非仅以工作年限评估能力
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进；建议将本文的阶段模型与泛化评估思路纳入内部检测工程流程评估

items.title: Partition-Matched Evaluation of Community Features under Distribution Shift in Android Malware Function-Call Graphs
items.summary: Graph-based Android malware classifiers can lose accuracy under malware-type or family shifts. We test whether mesoscopic organization in function-call graphs provides shift-stable information beyond local degree profiles (LDP), global statistics, lightweight metadata, and size-matched random partitions. Using 15,000 MalNet-Tiny, Common, and Distinct graphs, six Leiden descriptors specified before evaluation, and five optimizer seeds, communities raise Tiny macro F1 from 78.7% to 81.3% but yield 29.4-point source-only Common degradation. One size-matched random partition yields 27.8-point degradation. Across five random partitions, mean degradation is 27.9 points; the 95% two-level bootstrap interval for random minus community degradation is [-4.2, 1.2] points. With metadata, the corresponding difference is -0.2 points with interval [-1.1, 0.6]. Removing modularity raises structure-only Common macro F1 from 51.9% to 53.6%. The tested signature adds IID signal but shows no repeatable shift-stability advantage, demonstrating why mesoscopic graph claims need partition-matched controls and repeated null draws.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究基于函数调用图 (function-call graph) 的 Android 恶意软件分类器在分布偏移下的鲁棒性问题。已有图分类器在遇到恶意软件类型或家族分布变化 (shift) 时精度会显著下滑, 作者因此检验一个具体假设: 函数调用图中的介观 (mesoscopic) 组织结构——即社区划分所刻画的模块化结构——是否能提供超越局部度分布画像 (LDP)、全局统计量、轻量级元数据以及规模匹配的随机划分的、对分布偏移稳定的判别信息。实验使用 15,000 张来自 MalNet-Tiny、MalNet-Common 和 MalNet-Distinct 的函数调用图; 在评估前预先固定了 6 个 Leiden 社区描述符, 并采用 5 个优化器随机种子以控制随机性。结果显示: 引入社区特征使 MalNet-Tiny 上的宏 F1 从 78.7% 提升到 81.3%, 表面看有增益; 但在 Common 子集上仅用源域训练时, 退化幅度高达 29.4 个百分点。关键对照实验表明, 规模匹配的随机划分也能造成 27.8 个百分点的退化; 跨 5 次随机划分的平均退化是 27.9 个百分点, 随机划分减社区划分退化差的 95% 两层 bootstrap 区间为 [-4.2, 1.2] 个百分点, 区间包含 0, 即社区特征并未带来可重复的偏移稳定性优势。加入元数据后对应差异为 -0.2 个百分点, 区间 [-1.1, 0.6], 同样不显著。此外, 移除模块度 (modularity) 反而使纯结构 Common 宏 F1 从 51.9% 升至 53.6%。作者结论是: 所测试的这一签名只带来 IID (同分布) 上的信号增益, 却不具备可重复的分布偏移稳定性, 说明任何关于介观图结构的性能主张都必须配备分区匹配的对照实验与重复的零假设抽样, 否则容易把随机划分的效应误认成结构信息。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接质疑了恶意软件图分类中'社区/介观结构更鲁棒'的常见说法, 并给出一套可复用的评估范式 (分区匹配对照 + 重复零抽样 + bootstrap 区间)。对依赖 GNN 做 Android 恶意软件检测的团队, 这意味着现有的跨家族泛化宣称可能被高估, 评估方法需要修正。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到所有基于图结构的恶意软件/二进制相似性检测模型 (函数调用图、控制流图、API 调用图) 的离线评估与上线前验收: 强制加入规模匹配随机划分基线、重复种子与置信区间, 避免把 IID 增益误判为鲁棒性。
detection_signals_zh: 生产环境中图分类器在新型家族样本上宏 F1 相较验证集骤降 20 个百分点以上, 提示存在分布偏移而非单纯阈值问题
模型性能高度依赖是否加入模块度类整体图统计特征, 移除后指标反而上升, 说明该特征在跨分布场景提供的是噪声
仅用元数据 (文件大小、权限数等) 的基线在偏移集上表现与复杂图模型接近, 提示模型泛化能力被高估
defense_advice_zh: 在恶意软件图分类器的评估流程中固定加入规模匹配的随机划分对照组, 并对多次随机划分做统计检验, 而非只报告单次结果
报告跨家族/跨类型偏移下的退化幅度与 bootstrap 置信区间, 区间跨 0 时不得宣称结构特征带来鲁棒性收益
上线前用近期真实新家族样本做时间外推测试, 而非仅依赖同分布测试集
保留 LDP、全局统计与元数据等简单基线作为对照下限, 复杂介观特征需明确证明增量价值
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Residual Community Prototypes Under-Reject Held-Out Malware Families in FCG-MFD
items.summary: Open-set malware-family recognition must classify known families while rejecting families absent from training. We test whether Louvain-community summaries add rejection information beyond a graph neural network embedding and dimension-matched generic topology. The study uses a deduplicated, conflict-audited FCG-MFD corpus, five held-out families, and three optimization seeds. Community features are residualized against generic topology using known-family training data before nearest-prototype scoring. Residual community does not produce stable held-out-family rejection. Ranking effects reverse across families, the false-positive rate at 95 percent unknown recall worsens for every held-out family, and a validation-fitted threshold rejects only 4.48 percent of unknown samples. Accepted-known macro F1 improves in every family, but with five independent family units the exact two-sided sign-flip p-value is 0.0625, the smallest attainable value. The score remains associated with graph scale, while simple classifier uncertainty performs better on ranking, high-recall rejection, and OSCR. In this GIN/FCG-MFD setting, community-enriched prototypes change known-class geometry without creating a stable unknown margin. Graph open-set evaluations should pair structural features with matched topology controls, operational thresholds, and held-out-family analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究开放集（open-set）恶意软件家族识别中的一个关键问题：模型不仅要正确分类训练中出现过的已知家族，还必须拒识训练集中从未见过的未知家族。作者检验一个常见直觉——用 Louvain 社区划分对函数调用图（FCG）做社区摘要，是否能在图神经网络（GIN）嵌入之外提供额外的拒识信息。为避免把普通的图拓扑规模差异误当成“社区”增益，他们引入维度匹配的通用拓扑特征作为对照，并用已知家族训练数据把社区特征对通用拓扑做残差化（residualization），再以最近原型（nearest-prototype）打分。实验使用去重且经过冲突审计的 FCG-MFD 语料、5 个被留出的家族、3 个优化随机种子。结果显示：残差社区特征无法稳定拒识留出家族——排序效应在不同家族之间方向相反，在 95% 未知召回率下每一个留出家族的假阳性率都变差，按验证集拟合出的阈值只能拒识 4.48% 的未知样本。已知类的宏 F1 在每个家族上都有提升，但只有 5 个独立家族单元，精确双侧符号翻转检验的 p 值为 0.0625，已是该样本量下最小可取值，不具统计显著性。此外拒识分数仍与图规模相关，而简单的分类器不确定性在排序、高召回拒识与 OSCR 指标上表现更好。结论是：在该 GIN/FCG-MFD 设定下，社区增强原型只改变了已知类的几何结构，并未制造出稳定的未知边界。作者据此建议，图结构的开放集评测应同时引入匹配的拓扑对照、面向运营的阈值和留出家族分析。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多数恶意软件分类研究默认图结构特征能提升未知家族拒识；本文以严格对照给出反例，提醒蓝队与检测工程团队不要轻信此类增益声明，并提供了可复用的开放集评测规范。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响恶意软件家族分类模型的上线评估与拒识阈值选择：若沿用社区特征原型方案，在高召回要求下可能大量漏放未知家族样本。结论可迁移到任何依赖图结构的开放集检测场景，如 APT 家族聚类、IoT 固件与二进制相似性分类。
detection_signals_zh: 模型在验证集拟合阈值下对未知家族样本的拒识率极低（仅 4.48%），说明线上拒识阈值不可直接沿用
拒识分数与输入图规模强相关，大图/小图之间存在系统性偏置，可观测为按文件规模分布的分层误报
拒识排序在不同留出家族间方向相反，表现为跨家族性能方差异常大而非稳定提升
defense_advice_zh: 在引入社区/结构特征前，必须先构造维度匹配的通用拓扑对照组，确认增益并非来自图规模等混杂因素
开放集拒识阈值应按留出家族单独评估，避免用单一验证集阈值直接上线；同时报告 FPR@95% unknown recall 与 OSCR
把简单分类器不确定性（如 softmax 熵、置信度校准）作为基线纳入对照，避免过度复杂的结构原型方案
将留出家族数量纳入统计效力评估，家族单元过少时的显著性结论应视为探索性
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部恶意软件分类模型评估规范

items.title: Domain Specific Post Quantum Signatures for Blockchains
items.summary: Blockchains need more than post quantum single signer signatures. They need consensus profiled authentication objects with canonical bytes, priced invalid input rejection, stable transaction identifiers, hybrid downgrade resistance, public aggregation, merge semantics, accountable signer evidence, forward secure committee rotation, and light client consequences. We argue for domain specific post quantum signatures for blockchain roles, analogously to how hash function engineering produced domain specific primitives for hash table DoS and arithmetized proof systems. We formalize transaction authorization and quorum certificate requirements, instantiate them on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and a Sei Giga style high throughput BFT stress profile, and evaluate ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon/FN-DSA, HAWK, MAYO, SNOVA, UOV/QR-UOV, FAEST, SQIsign, LaBRADOR Falcon, Squirrel, Chipmunk, and DKKW/LeanSig. The conclusion is blunt. NIST single signer signatures are necessary components, although none of the current schemes is a drop in replacement for the signature layer of modern public blockchains. The missing object is a consensus ready post quantum signature profile, not another generic size table.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文指出，区块链对后量子密码的需求远不止于"单签名者签名方案"的替换。作者认为，区块链真正需要的是面向共识的认证对象，其必须具备一组工程属性：规范化的字节编码、对无效输入的有价拒绝（避免无偿拒绝服务）、稳定的交易标识符、混合签名下的降级抵抗、公开聚合能力、合并语义、可问责的签名者证据、支持委员会轮换的前向安全性，以及对轻客户端的影响评估。作者类比哈希函数工程曾为哈希表 DoS 防护和算术化证明系统催生出领域专用原语，主张为区块链的不同角色设计"领域专用后量子签名"。论文形式化了交易授权与 quorum certificate（法定人数证书）的需求模型，并在比特币、以太坊以及一种 Sei Giga 风格的高吞吐 BFT 压力画像上进行实例化，随后系统评估了 ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、Falcon/FN-DSA、HAWK、MAYO、SNOVA、UOV/QR-UOV、FAEST、SQIsign、LaBRADOR Falcon、Squirrel、Chipmunk 以及 DKKW/LeanSig 等一系列后量子签名方案。其结论直截了当：NIST 标准化的单签名者签名是必要组件，但目前没有任何一个方案能够直接替换现代公链的签名层。真正缺失的产物不是又一张通用的尺寸/性能对比表，而是一个"共识就绪"的后量子签名 profile（配置规范）。该论文适合区块链协议研究者、后量子密码工程团队以及负责公链长期密码迁移路线的架构师阅读，它把问题从"选哪个签名方案"提升到"如何定义共识层的认证对象规范"这一层面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 后量子迁移是公链中长期且不可回避的风险，论文强调单纯替换签名算法不足以保证共识安全与性能，需要面向共识的签名 profile，直接影响方案选型、协议设计与迁移审计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到公链/联盟链的后量子迁移路线规划、共识协议中交易授权与 quorum certificate 设计、以及后量子签名方案的工程评估与选型流程。
defense_advice_zh: 在后量子迁移评估中，把共识层认证对象需求（规范化编码、稳定标识符、聚合与合并语义、前向安全轮换等）纳入评审清单，而非仅比较签名尺寸与速度。
跟踪是否出现面向共识的标准化后量子签名 profile 提案，并评估其对现有链上验证逻辑与轻客户端的影响。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Beyond Predictable Paths: Redefining AI Security Incident Reporting for Agents
items.summary: AI agents are being deployed rapidly, accompanied by a growing number of AI-specific attacks and corresponding incidents. As incident reporting becomes increasingly important for legal compliance, governance, accountability, and security; current frameworks must be adapted to the unique characteristics of AI agents. In this paper, two editorial authors compare AI systems and AI agents and, drawing on input from 23 experts in academia and industry, identify the information required for reporting incidents where the security of AI agents is harmed. %involving AI agents. Potential reporting elements include, for example, agent memory and memory accesses, actual and potential levels of autonomy, and tool usage. Based on these findings, we identify several open research questions, including how to efficiently record incidents and how to determine whether vulnerabilities and incidents generalize. Expert feedback also highlighted potential reporting weaknesses, such as risks of data leakage and attacks targeting the reporting infrastructure itself, creating additional research needs. Lastly, we summarize privacy requirements and outline research directions for the secure and trustworthy deployment of AI agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于 AI 智能体（AI agent）快速落地过程中日益突出的安全事件报送问题。作者指出，随着针对 AI 系统的特定攻击与相应事件不断增加，事件报送在合规、治理、问责与安全运营中的地位愈发关键，但现行的事件报送框架主要面向传统软件与信息系统，无法覆盖 AI 智能体的独有特征，因此必须进行适配与重构。论文由两位编辑作者牵头，首先对「AI 系统」与「AI 智能体」进行对比分析，明确二者在行为主体性、状态持久性与外部交互能力上的差异；随后综合 23 位来自学术界与工业界专家的意见，梳理出在「AI 智能体安全性受到损害」这类事件中进行报送所需的关键信息要素。论文提出的潜在报送要素包括：智能体的记忆内容与记忆访问记录、实际自主性与潜在自主性等级、以及工具调用（tool usage）情况等。基于这些要素，作者进一步提炼出若干开放性研究问题，例如如何以可扩展且高效的方式记录事件，以及如何判断某个漏洞或事件是否具有可泛化性（即是否会跨模型、跨部署、跨任务复现）。专家反馈还揭示了报送机制本身存在的薄弱环节，包括敏感信息泄露风险，以及针对报送基础设施自身的攻击，这催生了新的研究需求。最后，论文总结了事件报送中的隐私合规要求，并给出了面向 AI 智能体安全可信部署的研究方向。整体而言，这是一篇立场与框架类（position/framework）论文，主要贡献是提出 AI 智能体事件报送的信息要素集合、研究议程与隐私与安全考量，而非具体的检测算法或实证测评。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 事件报送格式与要素将直接影响 SOC 如何取证、归因与合规披露 AI 智能体事件。该文给出的要素集合（记忆访问、自主性等级、工具调用）可作为企业构建 agent 日志与事件响应流程的参考基线，并提示报送基础设施本身即是新的攻击面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于部署 LLM 智能体的企业安全团队、AI 治理与合规部门、CERT/CSIRT 事件报送标准制定方，以及 agent 可观测性与审计日志产品设计。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体记忆的异常读取或写入（越权访问、跨会话记忆污染痕迹）
工具调用序列偏离既定策略或出现未授权工具/参数组合
智能体自主性等级在运行期发生非预期变化（如从人工确认转为全自动执行）
针对事件报送/审计通道本身的异常访问、篡改或数据外泄迹象
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体运行时补齐记忆访问、工具调用与自主性变更三类审计日志，并保证日志不可篡改、与业务数据分离存储
将事件报送基础设施纳入关键资产清单，按高风险系统进行访问控制、完整性校验与可用性防护
在事件报送内容中做敏感信息最小化与脱敏处理，避免报送流程本身成为数据泄露渠道
对智能体漏洞与事件建立泛化性评估维度（跨模型、跨版本、跨任务），避免单点修复后误判风险已消除
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入内部 AI 智能体事件响应与日志规范评估

items.title: Passive Hybrid Network-Based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) Combining Suricata and Random Forest
items.summary: This paper evaluates a passive Hybrid Network-based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) prototype that combines Suricata with Random Forest flow classification and centralized ELK-based alert handling. The study explicitly separates benchmark evaluation from PCAP/live operational validation and controls exact feature-duplicate leakage using feature hashing and group-aware splitting. From 2,540,047 UNSW-NB15 records, 453 conflicting-label hash groups containing 1,879 rows were removed; the resulting Development and Hold-out sets have zero exact feature-hash overlap. RF-41 achieved F1 = 0.971360 and ROC-AUC = 0.999671, while the NFStream-compatible RF-21 achieved F1 = 0.970148 on the same prepared hold-out boundary. However, operational validation revealed substantial benchmark-to-deployment domain shift: on a labeled laboratory PCAP, RF-21 and the strictly correlated branch achieved recall of only 0.0095, and RF-21 produced no alerts in five additional 60-second attack sessions. An unlabeled normal-traffic test produced 439 alerts from 2,375 flows; this value is reported only as an alert ratio and is not interpreted as a false-positive rate. These results show that strong performance on a public benchmark does not directly translate into operational effectiveness. Accordingly, the current Hybrid-NIDS should be interpreted as a passive prototype and evaluation framework, and the reported experiments do not demonstrate that Suricata-Random Forest correlation provides better operational detection than Suricata alone.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对一个被动式混合网络入侵检测系统（Hybrid-NIDS）原型进行了评估，该原型将 Suricata 规则引擎、基于随机森林（Random Forest）的流量分类以及基于 ELK 的集中式告警处理三者结合。研究的核心问题是：在公开数据集上表现优异的机器学习流量分类器，是否能在真实运营环境中转化为有效检测能力。为避免方法学上的常见偏差，作者刻意将基准测试评估与 PCAP/实流运营验证分离，并使用特征哈希配合分组感知（group-aware）的数据划分来控制“精确特征重复”导致的数据泄漏：从 UNSW-NB15 的 2,540,047 条记录中，剔除了 453 个存在标签冲突的哈希组（共 1,879 行），最终得到的开发集与留出集之间精确特征哈希重叠为零。在该严格留出边界上，使用 41 维特征的 RF-41 取得 F1 = 0.971360、ROC-AUC = 0.999671；兼容 NFStream 特征管线的 21 维 RF-21 取得 F1 = 0.970148。然而，运营验证暴露出显著的“基准到部署”域偏移（domain shift）：在一个带标签的实验室 PCAP 上，RF-21 以及与其严格相关的检测分支召回率仅为 0.0095；在另外五个 60 秒攻击会话中，RF-21 完全没有产生任何告警。在未标注的正常流量测试中，2,375 条流触发了 439 条告警，作者仅将其作为告警比（alert ratio）报告，明确拒绝将其解读为误报率。论文的主要贡献因此是双重的：一是提供了一套可复现、抗泄漏的混合 NIDS 评估框架与流程；二是通过实验证据指出，公开基准的强指标并不直接等同于运营检测有效性，现有 Hybrid-NIDS 应被定位为被动原型与评测框架，且其实验结果并未证明 Suricata 与随机森林的关联告警优于单独使用 Suricata。适合网络安全研究者、NIDS 研发与评测人员，以及关注 ML 检测落地的蓝队/SOC 工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它用实测数据戳破了 ML 型 NIDS 的“基准幻觉”：公开数据集 F1 近 0.97，实验室 PCAP 召回却只有 0.0095，多个攻击会话零告警。若仅凭基准指标选型或上线，会形成严重检测盲区。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到企业自研或采购 ML/混合 NIDS 的选型与验收场景：提示在 UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS 等公开集上的高分不能作为上线依据，必须以本地抓包与实流回放做二次验证；同时其“特征哈希 + 分组划分”抗泄漏流程可用于内部模型评测规范；也适用于解释为何 ML 分支接入 Suricata 后未必带来增益。
detection_signals_zh: 带标签实验室 PCAP 回放时 ML 分支召回率极低（约 0.0095），与基准指标严重背离
连续多个短时攻击会话（如 60 秒）中 ML 检测分支零告警输出
正常流量下告警量与流量规模之比异常（2,375 流产生 439 条告警），需以告警比而非误报率跟踪
Suricata 规则告警与 ML 流分类告警的关联结果未表现出优于单规则引擎的检测增益
训练集与留出集之间若未做特征哈希去重，可能出现精确特征重叠导致的虚高评测指标
defense_advice_zh: 不要把公开数据集 F1/ROC-AUC 当作部署就绪的证明，任何 ML NIDS 上线前必须用本地 PCAP 与实流回放做独立验证
在数据准备阶段实施特征哈希去重与分组感知划分，消除精确特征重复造成的评测泄漏，并留存重叠度审计记录
对 ML 检测分支单独埋点监控召回、告警量基线与会话覆盖率，避免其被规则引擎告警掩盖而长期失效
评估报告应区分基准指标与运营指标，误报率需基于带标注流量计算，未标注数据只可报告告警比
在混合架构中先验证 ML 分支相对纯 Suricata 的增量价值，无增益时不要增加运维复杂度与告警噪声
排查基准到部署的域偏移根因（特征提取差异、NFStream 与训练管线不一致、流量分布与时间跨度差异），再做特征与阈值回归
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：纳入内部 NIDS/ML 检测评估流程，作为“基准不可直接外推”的方法学参照，并复核现有 ML 检测分支的真实召回。

items.title: Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model
items.summary: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synthesizes shared patterns while preserving the distinction between native and pooled quantities. Cross-paper comparisons are restricted to aligned evidence; differences in release, population, preprocessing, training, or benchmark exposure are context rather than rank. The findings characterize performance on evaluated records, not universal reliability, calibration, attribution, or future adaptive attacks. By keeping benchmark-native outcomes distinct from pooled summaries, the study makes test-population, class-balance, and missing-record-coverage differences visible. It supports interpretation of detector results in research, platform-safety, and forensic-review settings, foregrounding traceable protocol conditions over claims or leaderboard comparisons.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 AI 生成图像/合成媒体检测领域的一个核心痛点：检测器能力演进速度快于基准评测的更新速度，导致单一榜单分数无法完整反映模型的泛化能力。作者系统评测了 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B 这一基础多模态深度伪造检测模型，在多个基准家族（benchmark families）上进行测试，且不针对任何特定基准做参数更新（即不做基准专有的微调）。在方法上，研究保留各基准的原生聚合口径，并补充三类诊断：记录级（record-level）度量、覆盖率统计（coverage accounting）以及子群（subgroup）诊断，以避免汇总分数掩盖数据分布问题。每个结果小节都明确标注所用基准的发布版本与评估人群，报告官方指标并描述观察到的错误模式；组合分析进一步综合共性模式，同时严格区分“基准原生量”与“合并汇总量”。跨论文比较被限制在对齐证据范围内，发布版本、评估人群、预处理、训练数据或基准暴露度的差异被视为上下文而非排名依据。论文强调其结论仅限于被评估记录上的表现，不等同于通用可靠性、概率校准、来源归因或对未来自适应攻击的鲁棒性。主要贡献在于：通过把基准原生结果与合并摘要分离，使测试人群差异、类别不平衡差异、缺失记录覆盖差异变得可见，从而支持在科研、平台安全与取证复核场景中更可追溯、更谨慎地解释检测器结果，推动以协议条件为中心的评测文化，而非榜单排名式结论。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 深度伪造检测器的选型与上线常被单一基准分数左右，而该工作表明分数高度依赖评估人群、类别平衡与记录覆盖率。对平台内容安全和取证团队而言，它提供了避免将基准成绩误等同于真实部署可靠性的方法论与可追溯披露要求。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至合成媒体检测模型的采购评估、内容审核模型上线前验证、以及司法/取证复核中对检测结论的证据化解读与不确定性披露流程。
defense_advice_zh: 要求检测器供应商披露评测基准版本、评估人群、类别分布与缺失记录覆盖率，而非仅提供单一汇总分数。
在内部评测中同时保留基准原生指标与自定义记录级/子群指标，避免类别不平衡和覆盖缺失被平均值掩盖。
跨模型对比前先对齐数据发布版本、预处理与训练暴露度；不一致时仅作为上下文，不做排名结论。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: When Label Noise Meets Class Imbalance: A Robust Framework for Android Malware Family Classification
items.summary: Machine learning methods for Android malware family classification have achieved high accuracy, but their application is hindered by two major challenges. First, the widely used code obfuscation severely disrupts the automated labeling process and introduces substantial label noise into training datasets. Second, training datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, leading to poor performance of family classification models. Although existing studies have proposed various solutions to either label noise or class imbalance, they often overlook the interplay between these two factors. Under class imbalance, the presence of hard-to-learn minority-class samples can significantly impair the effectiveness of existing countermeasures for noisy samples. To jointly address label noise and class imbalance, we propose a robust Android malware family classification framework, RoMaC. It employs a self-training strategy to correct noisy labels and, more importantly, discriminately treats head-family and tail-family samples. This design effectively mitigates the adverse impact of class imbalance on noise-robust learning. Moreover, RoMaC integrates a class reweighting mechanism with multi-model ensemble learning, thereby enhancing both classification accuracy and noise robustness. We evaluate RoMaC on a combined dataset constructed from two public datasets. When 30% of the samples are obfuscated, RoMaC achieves an overall Macro-F1 score of 0.803 and an accuracy of 0.871, as well as a tail-class Macro-F1 score of 0.672 and an accuracy of 0.784. Compared with existing methods, RoMaC demonstrates performance improvements of 6%-20% across various obfuscation scenarios and noise levels.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是 Android 恶意软件家族分类模型在真实训练数据条件下的鲁棒性问题。作者指出现有机器学习方法虽在基准数据集上准确率很高，但落地时面临两大障碍：其一，Android 生态中广泛使用的代码混淆会严重干扰自动化标注流程，导致训练集中混入大量噪声标签；其二，家族样本分布天然高度不均衡，头部家族样本充裕而尾部家族样本稀少，使模型在长尾家族上表现很差。已有工作通常只单独处理标签噪声或类别不均衡，忽视了二者的耦合效应——在类别不均衡条件下，少数类中难以学习的样本会显著削弱现有噪声标签纠错机制的效果。为此，论文提出鲁棒分类框架 RoMaC，核心设计包括：采用自训练（self-training）策略对噪声标签进行纠正；在此基础上区分对待头部家族与尾部家族样本，从而抑制类别不均衡对噪声鲁棒学习的负面影响；并进一步将类别重加权机制与多模型集成学习结合，同时提升分类精度与抗噪能力。实验在两个公开数据集合并构建的数据集上进行，当 30% 样本被混淆时，RoMaC 取得整体 Macro-F1 0.803、准确率 0.871，尾部类 Macro-F1 0.672、准确率 0.784；在不同混淆场景与噪声水平下，相较已有方法提升 6% 至 20%。论文面向的研究问题、方法与评测口径，适合恶意软件检测、威胁情报建模及安全机器学习方向的研究者与工程团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 移动恶意软件检测严重依赖标注质量与样本分布，标签噪声与类别不均衡叠加是防御方模型在真实环境退化的常见根因。该工作给出了可迁移的协同处理思路与量化指标，有助于评估并改进自有家族分类流水线在混淆与长尾场景下的可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 Android 恶意家族分类、恶意样本标注清洗、长尾威胁类别检测、混淆样本鲁棒训练等场景；对使用自动化标注构建训练集的 SOC/安全厂商建模团队有直接参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 模型在尾部家族上的召回率与 Macro-F1 显著低于整体准确率，提示长尾失衡影响
训练样本标签与模型预测存在系统性冲突，可能为自动化标注引入的标签噪声
混淆样本比例升高时模型判定置信度分布异常偏移，可用于监控模型退化
同一模型在不同混淆比例子集上的性能差异超过阈值，提示鲁棒性不足
defense_advice_zh: 在恶意家族分类训练流程中加入标签质量校验与人工复核抽样，降低自动化标注噪声
评估模型时按家族频次分层统计指标，避免仅看整体准确率掩盖尾部类缺陷
引入类别重加权、长尾采样或多模型集成等策略，提升少数家族与混淆样本的检测稳定性
在混淆比例、噪声比例等不同条件下做分层压力测试，沉淀可复现的鲁棒性基线
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Quantum ROP: Using Quantum Algorithms for ROP Chain Selection in Exploit Construction
items.summary: The quantum computing threat to cybersecurity is nowadays predominantly framed around Shor's algorithm and its eventual capacity to break asymmetric cryptography. Beyond cryptanalysis, however, quantum computing may also enable other capabilities in offensive security. This work explores one such direction: the application of quantum combinatorial optimization to Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) gadget selection for exploit construction. We formulate gadget selection as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem that captures individual gadget cost and inter-gadget register-clobbering interactions, and solve it using QAOA on real IBM Heron r2 hardware. Applied to a Linux kernel exploitation scenario, the QAOA-selected chain achieves privilege escalation to uid=0 with SMEP and SMAP active. Across eight Linux binaries and 16 benchmark instances, QAOA recovered the lowest-cost valid chain in 11 cases; in the remaining five, it did not recover the optimum, with the failures associated with excessive circuit depth on current limited hardware.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文跳出了当前量子计算安全威胁讨论的常规框架。目前业界对量子威胁的主流叙事几乎完全围绕 Shor 算法及其最终破解 RSA/ECC 等非对称密码的能力展开，而作者指出，量子计算在密码分析之外还可能为攻击性安全领域带来新的能力。本文探索的正是这样一个方向：把量子组合优化应用于返回导向编程（ROP）中的 gadget 选择环节，从而影响漏洞利用构造过程。

核心方法上，作者将 gadget 选择问题形式化为一个二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）问题，目标函数同时刻画了两类要素：一是单个 gadget 自身的代价（例如指令数量、链长度等开销），二是 gadget 之间相互干扰的寄存器污染（register-clobbering）关系——即前一个 gadget 对寄存器的写操作会破坏后一个 gadget 所依赖的值，这类耦合约束正是 ROP 链自动构造中难以用贪心或线性方法处理的部分。QUBO 形式天然适合量子退火与变分量子算法求解，作者选择了量子近似优化算法（QAOA），并在真实的 IBM Heron r2 硬件上完成求解，而非仅做模拟。

实验部分，作者将该方法应用于一个 Linux 内核漏洞利用场景，结果表明 QAOA 选出的 gadget 链在 SMEP 与 SMAP 两项硬件缓解措施均处于开启状态的前提下，仍实现了提权至 uid=0。更广泛的评测覆盖 8 个 Linux 二进制、共 16 个基准实例：QAOA 在其中 11 个实例上找到了最低代价的合法链，即命中最优解；剩余 5 个实例未能恢复最优解，作者分析失败原因与当前硬件条件下电路深度过大有关。

主要贡献可归纳为三点：首次系统性地将 ROP gadget 选择建模为 QUBO 并用真实量子硬件求解；给出包含寄存器污染交互的代价建模方式；通过对 16 个实例的实证评估，量化了当前 NISQ 硬件在组合优化类攻击任务上的能力边界与瓶颈。该工作适合量子计算安全、漏洞利用与自动化攻击面、以及量子算法应用方向的研究者阅读，其价值在于提示防御方：量子威胁面可能不局限于密码学，也可能延伸到自动化漏洞利用构造。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把量子计算威胁的讨论从“破解密码”扩展到“自动化构造漏洞利用链”，说明量子组合优化可能成为攻击工具链的一环。虽然当前硬件只能解决小规模实例，但方向值得防御方提前纳入威胁建模与缓解措施规划。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 短期内不具备直接实战价值，受限于 NISQ 硬件电路深度；但方法可迁移到任何可被形式化为组合优化的攻击构造问题，如 gadget 选择、链式利用、约束求解类漏洞利用自动化。对依赖 ROP 链构造难度的缓解措施（如 SMEP/SMAP、CET/CFI）构成长期理论压力。
defense_advice_zh: 关注量子优化算法在自动化漏洞利用构造中的研究进展，将其纳入长期威胁建模而非当前应急响应范围。
持续推动并验证硬件级控制流完整性（CET/CFI）与细粒度内存保护，降低 ROP 链可用性，从根本上削弱此类优化方法的收益。
对内核提权类利用保持常规遥测覆盖，例如异常权限变更、提权至 uid=0 的审计事件与可疑模块加载行为。
评估关键系统中 ROP 缓解组合（SMEP/SMAP/CET/KASLR）的开启率，避免仅依赖单一缓解措施。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: SkelOT: Reusing AOT Compilation Across EVM Contract Families
items.summary: Ahead-of-time (AOT) compilers (e.g., revmc, evmone, and DTVM) for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) reuse compilation artifacts at contract-code-hash granularity. This granularity is poorly matched to real EVM workloads dominated by \emph{contract families}: factory-, proxy-, and template-driven deployments that share instruction structure but differ in a small set of embedded constants. Across four EVM chains (Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum), we find that 23.1--47.6\% of unique compilable bytecodes map to shared family skeletons within 10K-block windows. Per-hash AOT therefore redundantly recompiles structurally equivalent code, inflating compile time and artifact footprint while reducing workload coverage under finite compile budgets. We present \textsc{SkelOT}, an AOT framework that lifts the unit of compilation reuse from code hash to family skeleton. \textsc{SkelOT} compiles one native artifact per family, bakes invariant constants into the artifact, and reads variant constants from a per-contract runtime table. Built on revmc/LLVM and evaluated on a 10K-block Base mainnet corpus (3.52M transactions), \textsc{SkelOT} reduces compilation units by 47.5\%, artifact footprint by 57.4\%, and compile time by $2.19\times$, while preserving byte-identical execution outcomes versus per-hash AOT. At runtime, \textsc{SkelOT} delivers a $1.31\times$ median per-contract speedup across family members. Under a compile budget targeting 75\% execution-time coverage, \textsc{SkelOT} needs far fewer artifacts than per-hash AOT, and the advantage holds at every coverage target.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注以太坊虚拟机(EVM)的提前编译(AOT)优化问题。当前主流 AOT 编译器(如 revmc、evmone、DTVM)以「合约代码哈希」(contract-code-hash)为粒度缓存与复用编译产物。作者指出,这一粒度与真实链上负载的分布严重不匹配:实际流量由「合约家族」(contract families)主导,即由工厂合约(factory)、代理合约(proxy)和模板驱动部署产生的合约集合。这些合约的指令结构高度一致,仅在少数内嵌常量(如地址、参数、阈值)上存在差异。作者在 Base、Ethereum、BSC、Arbitrum 四条 EVM 链上做了测量,发现在 10K 区块窗口内,23.1%–47.6% 的唯一可编译字节码可以映射到共享的家族「骨架」(skeleton)。这意味着按哈希逐一编译会重复编译结构等价的代码,既拉长编译时间、膨胀编译产物占用,又在有限编译预算下降低了实际可覆盖的负载比例。为此论文提出 SkelOT 框架,把编译复用的单位从「代码哈希」提升到「家族骨架」:每个家族只编译一份原生产物,把不变量常量直接烘焙(bake)进产物中,而把随合约变化的常量通过每合约的运行时常量表(runtime table)读取。SkelOT 构建于 revmc/LLVM 之上,并在 Base 主网 10K 区块语料(352 万笔交易)上评测。结果显示:编译单元数减少 47.5%,编译产物体积减少 57.4%,编译时间缩短 2.19 倍,且执行结果与按哈希 AOT 逐字节一致(byte-identical),即不引入语义偏差;运行时对同一家族成员的中位单合约加速为 1.31 倍。在设定 75% 执行时间覆盖率目标的编译预算下,SkelOT 所需产物数量远少于按哈希 AOT,并且这一优势在所有覆盖率目标下均成立。整体而言,这是一项系统/编译器层面的性能与工程效率工作,面向节点运营、执行层客户端开发者与链上性能研究群体。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: EVM 执行层性能直接影响节点同步速度、状态访问延迟与 RPC/MEV 基础设施成本。该工作表明按哈希编译存在系统性冗余,改用家族骨架粒度可在不改变执行语义的前提下显著降低编译时间与产物体积,对节点与执行层客户端的资源优化具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 EVM 执行层客户端(revmc、evmone、DTVM 类)、链上节点运营与区块构建/仿真基础设施;对需要批量回放历史区块的链上分析平台同样有编译缓存优化意义。
detection_signals_zh: 链上出现同一字节码骨架、仅少量内嵌常量不同的合约批量部署(工厂/代理/模板模式),可作为家族聚类的观测特征
短时间内同一编译单元被反复请求编译,反映按哈希缓存的缓存未命中与冗余编译
defense_advice_zh: 在自建节点或回放环境中评估按家族骨架缓存编译产物的收益,并在灰度环境验证执行结果与按哈希编译逐字节一致
将编译预算与覆盖率指标纳入执行层性能基线,定期统计唯一可编译字节码的家族聚集度
对代理/工厂/模板类部署模式建立清单,便于评估编译缓存策略的覆盖效果
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Endogenous Interpretation
items.summary: We propose endogenous interpretation: program, interpreter, machine, and derived execution language are not disjoint semantic objects but different parameterizations of one executable state-transition relation. Each realization carries an implicit constraint bias, the structural restrictions imposed by its instruction basis, state encoding, control transfers, and finite substrate. From this viewpoint the "semantic gap" metaphor is misleading for operational semantics: a semantics-preserving transformation cannot remove the computation required for execution; it redistributes it over another state space and transition granularity (semantic diffusion). Reverse engineering is then the recovery of a lower-complexity semantic contraction. We give a first quantitative instance. For finite-state realizations observed up to bisimulation, the contraction is canonical and computable in almost-linear time, yielding an abstraction-independent diffusion ratio; for deterministic realizations this extends to trace equivalence. For nondeterministic realizations observed up to traces, minimal contraction is

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出「内生解释」(endogenous interpretation) 这一理论视角,主张程序、解释器、机器以及派生的执行语言并不是彼此分离的语义对象,而是同一个可执行状态转移关系的不同参数化形式。作者进一步指出,每一种具体实现都携带一种「隐式约束偏置」,即由它的指令基 (instruction basis)、状态编码方式、控制转移机制以及有限基底 (finite substrate) 所施加的结构性限制。基于这一视角,论文认为在操作语义层面常被使用的「语义鸿沟」(semantic gap) 隐喻具有误导性:一个保持语义的变换并不能够消除执行所必需的计算量,它只能把这份计算重新分配( redistribute )到另一个状态空间与另一种转移粒度之上,作者将这一现象命名为「语义扩散」(semantic diffusion)。由此,逆向工程被重新刻画为「恢复一个更低复杂度的语义收缩」(semantic contraction),即从一个给定实现的高粒度转移结构中抽取出等价的、复杂度更低的语义表示。论文给出了首个定量化的实例:对于在互模拟 (bisimulation) 意义下可观测的有限状态实现,该收缩是规范的 (canonical),并且可以在近乎线性时间内计算出来,从而导出一个与具体抽象层次无关的「扩散比率」;对于确定性实现,该结论可进一步扩展到迹等价 (trace equivalence);对于在迹意义下可观测的非确定性实现,作者讨论了最小收缩问题(摘要在此处截断)。总体贡献在于:提供了一套统一程序与解释器的形式框架、给出了语义扩散的可计算度量,并为逆向工程建立了复杂度理论层面的刻画。适合形式化方法、程序语言理论、二进制分析与逆向工程方向的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把逆向工程从工程技巧提升为可度量的复杂度问题,为混淆强度评估、抽象层次选择与二进制分析工具的理论边界提供了统一语言;从事逆向与反混淆的团队值得跟踪其后续算法化工作。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到二进制分析与反编译、代码混淆/反混淆强度度量、程序等价性与互模拟判定、解释器与虚拟机语义设计,以及形式化验证中抽象层选择的评估场景。
defense_advice_zh: 将该框架的『扩散比率』概念纳入内部对混淆方案强度的理论评估维度,而非仅依赖经验性对抗测试。
在二进制分析与反编译工具链的抽象层次选择上,关注后续是否出现可落地的近似算法或工具原型。
安排理论岗或研究岗对该方向做文献跟踪,评估其对现有逆向工作流假设(如『语义鸿沟必然存在』)的修正意义。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Identifying Suspected Mislabeled Apps in Google Play Application Removal Prediction: An Empirical Comparison of Label Noise Detection Methods
items.summary: Models that predict which Google Play apps will be removed are trained on labels that record only whether an app was still in the store at a later observation. A disappeared app is labeled removed and a present one stable, but neither records why. A voluntary withdrawal and a policy takedown both produce removed, and an uncaught spam app keeps stable. This work calls that mismatch label noise. Three detectors from different methodological families are applied to the 870,514 apps of Mohsen, Karastoyanova, and Azzopardi (2022): Isolation Forest, flagging apps unusual in the feature space, Neighborhood Disagreement, flagging apps whose nearest neighbors carry the opposite label, and Prediction Inconsistency, flagging apps a classifier labels differently from the data. The apps flagged by all three, the overlap, number 7,598 at default settings and are the strongest mislabeling candidates. Two questions follow. First, does removing flagged apps improve the model? It does not. No detector, overlap, or union beats the baseline, and the loss grows with the number removed. Second, do flagged apps appear less often than expected among apps whose label VirusTotal and Quark Engine confirm? Among confirmed removals they do, falling to 0.43 times the expected rate as the threshold tightens, while an excess on the stable side disappears once the age of the scanned apps is accounted for. A model trained on only the 3,021 trainable overlap apps reaches a test AUC of 0.2518, far below chance, so the relationship between features and labels there runs opposite to the rest of the data. The flagged apps run wrong in both directions: abandoned apps that resemble spam carry stable, while apps that look healthy carry removed. The value of the detectors lies in characterizing this label noise. They locate a small set of candidates they cannot profitably remove.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
这篇论文研究 Google Play 应用下架预测任务中的「标签噪声」问题。现有预测模型通常只使用一个二值标签：在某个后续观测时点，应用若仍在商店中则标为 stable（稳定），若已消失则标为 removed（已下架）。但这个标签并不记录原因——开发者主动撤架与平台因违规策略强制下架都会产生 removed，而一个未被识别的垃圾/恶意应用则可能一直保留为 stable。作者把这种「标签与真实成因不匹配」的现象统称为 label noise，并认为它会系统性地污染训练数据与模型评估。

方法上，作者从三个不同方法学家族选取检测器，应用于 Mohsen、Karastoyanova 与 Azzopardi（2022）构建的 870,514 个应用数据集：一是 Isolation Forest，用于标记在特征空间中异常的应用；二是 Neighborhood Disagreement，标记最近邻携带相反标签的应用；三是 Prediction Inconsistency，标记被分类器判为与数据记录标签不一致的应用。三者的交集（overlap）在默认阈值下为 7,598 个应用，被视为最强的疑似错标候选。

随后论文回答两个问题。第一，删除被标记的应用能否提升模型？答案是否定的：无论单一检测器、交集还是并集，都不优于基线，且删除数量越多性能损失越大。第二，被标记应用在由 VirusTotal 与 Quark Engine 确认为真实下架的应用中是否低于预期出现？在已确认下架样本中确实如此，随着阈值收紧其出现率降至期望值的 0.43 倍；而 stable 一侧的超出部分在考虑被扫描应用的年龄因素后即消失。此外，仅用 3,021 个可训练的交集应用训练模型，测试 AUC 仅为 0.2518，远低于随机水平，说明该子集内特征与标签的关系与整体数据相反。被标记应用在两个方向上都会出错：像垃圾应用的弃置应用被标为 stable，而看起来健康的应用却被标为 removed。作者结论是：这些检测器的价值不在于可盈利地剔除样本，而在于刻画与定位这类标签噪声。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 下架预测、恶意应用识别等风控模型高度依赖标签质量；本文说明「下架原因不明」的二值标签会引入双向噪声，盲目按异常检测清洗数据反而降低性能（AUC 可低至 0.25），提醒安全团队在做应用商店治理与模型训练时需区分自愿撤架与强制下架。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到应用商店治理、移动恶意软件检测、内容/账号封禁预测等以「事后存在性」为标签的场景；也适用于任何用 VirusTotal 等多引擎确认结果做弱监督或标签校验的流水线，提示需要显式建模标签成因与扫描时间偏置。
detection_signals_zh: 模型评分与 VirusTotal / Quark Engine 确认的下架标签出现系统性背离（低于期望约 0.43 倍）的子集
特征空间孤立点、最近邻标签反转与分类器预测不一致三者同时命中的样本聚集现象
在特定子集上测试 AUC 显著低于 0.5（如 0.2518），提示特征-标签关系方向与总体相反
标签语义混淆：自愿撤架与策略下架共用同一 removed 标签，无法从标签本身区分
defense_advice_zh: 在训练下架/封禁预测模型前，先做标签语义审计，区分主动撤架与平台强制下架等不同成因，必要时改为多类别或分组建模
不要直接用异常检测结果清洗训练集；本文证明删除被标记样本不优于基线且删除越多损失越大
引入 VirusTotal、Quark Engine 等外部确认源做标签校验，并对扫描时间、应用年龄等偏置因素做分层或加权
监控子集 AUC 低于随机水平等反常评估指标，作为标签噪声或分布反向的信号
对被标记但与外部确认冲突的样本保留人工复核流程，而非自动剔除

items.title: Assessing Runtime Electromagnetic Detection of CPU Hardware Trojans Targeting Kernel Memory
items.summary: Side-channels are a promising approach for hardware trojan detection, as they can passively reveal malicious hardware activity without requiring additional circuitry or destructive analysis of the device under test. This work investigates the use of electromagnetic (EM) emanations for runtime detection of hardware trojan attacks. Using an open-source hardware trojan that implements an arbitrary memory-write primitive, we tamper with the kernel memory of a Linux system running on a RISC-V microarchitecture and perform a real-time baseline detection using the processor's EM emissions. Our results indicate that, under certain conditions, hardware trojans can be detected indirectly through the anomalous software behavior they enable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究硬件木马（hardware trojan）的运行时检测问题。传统硬件木马检测多依赖破坏性逆向工程或片上额外监测电路，成本高、难以在设备部署后持续运行。作者提出利用处理器运行时的电磁（EM）辐射作为被动侧信道，对运行中的系统做实时检测。为验证可行性，研究团队采用一个开源硬件木马实现，该木马具备任意内存写原语（arbitrary memory-write primitive），将其植入到基于 RISC-V 微架构、运行 Linux 的系统中，攻击目标为篡改内核内存（kernel memory）。实验通过采集处理器 EM 辐射建立实时基线，并监测偏离基线的异常。结果表明，在一定条件下，硬件木马可以借助其引发的软件行为异常被间接检测出来：即通过软件层可观测的异常行为反推硬件层恶意活动，而不必直接对 EM 信号做完整的模板匹配。论文主要贡献包括：一是给出了 EM 侧信道用于运行时硬件木马检测的实验评估框架；二是验证了“硬件木马—软件可观测副作用—EM 异常”这一间接检测链条在 RISC-V Linux 场景下的可行性；三是讨论了检测成立的前提条件与局限，如木马触发模式、EM 噪声环境、基线建立成本等。该工作适合硬件安全、供应链安全、侧信道分析与 RISC-V 可信计算方向的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件木马属于隐蔽的供应链级威胁，EM 检测无需额外片上电路、可在部署后被动运行。该研究提示防御者：硬件层恶意行为会通过内核内存篡改等软件可观测副作用暴露，值得将 EM 监测与内核完整性监控结合，用于关键设备的硬件可信验证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 RISC-V/ARM SoC 的供应链验收、数据中心服务器硬件完整性抽检、关键基础设施设备部署后运行时监测等场景；也适用于评估现有内核完整性方案对硬件层攻击的覆盖缺口。
detection_signals_zh: 处理器 EM 辐射频谱/幅度基线出现持续或周期性偏移，尤其在特定负载或触发条件附近
内核内存关键区域出现非预期写入或校验值变化（如内核数据结构完整性异常）
软件行为异常与 EM 异常在时间上高度相关（如权限提升、进程状态篡改伴随 EM 频谱变化）
EM 基线比对中出现的重复性、可控触发模式差异
defense_advice_zh: 对关键硬件平台（尤其 RISC-V/开源 SoC）在部署前后建立 EM 指纹基线，并纳入硬件验收流程
将 EM 侧信道监测与内核完整性度量（IMA/EVM、eBPF 内核行为监控）联动，交叉验证异常
在受控环境下定期进行硬件木马检测抽检，注意触发条件与电磁噪声控制
关注供应链来源与固件/硬件更新通道完整性，降低植入风险
避免仅依赖 EM 单一信号，建议多模态（功耗、时序、EM）融合判断

items.title: Searching for Primes: A Neural AlphaZero Approach to a Factoring Game
items.summary: We study a one-player token game on an $N\times N$ board where tokens slide along diagonals or duplicate onto neighbouring ones to form a combinatorial rectangle $R\times S$. A conserved integer weight $W'$ and a strict monovariant guarantee $O(N^2)$-length solutions, placing the game in $\mathsf{NP}$. We prove that reaching a final position factors this $2N$-bit $W'$ into two $N$-bit factors $V,M < 2^N$ that encode the rectangle's rows and columns. Consequently, solving the game for a balanced-semiprime target is equivalent to integer factoring. However, if the target rectangle is known, the solution reduces to two polynomial-time steps: a forced downward chip-flow and a $0/1$-polynomial factorisation leveraging Cohn's theorem. The game's entire difficulty is thus isolated to the initial number-theoretic split. Supplying the popcounts of the factors as a promise preserves this asymptotic hardness but bounds the target search space. We exploit this constrained space using a learned policy/value network and an AlphaZero-style Monte-Carlo tree search, empirically probing the limits of neural look-ahead on a factoring-equivalent environment.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文研究一个定义在 N×N 棋盘上的单人 token 游戏：token 可以沿对角线滑动，或复制到相邻格子上，最终目标是拼出一个组合矩形 R×S。作者指出，游戏中存在一个守恒的整数权重 W'，外加一个严格的单调量（monovariant），因此任意解的长度上界为 O(N^2)，这意味着该游戏的可解性问题落在 NP 之内。论文的核心理论结果是：当游戏走到终局位置时，这一过程等价于把 2N 比特的整数 W' 分解为两个 N 比特因子 V、M（均小于 2^N），而这两个因子恰好编码了目标矩形的行数与列数。因此，对平衡半素数（balanced semiprime）目标而言，求解该游戏与整数分解问题等价。

作者进一步证明，如果目标矩形已经预先知道，求解过程会退化为两个多项式时间步骤：第一步是被强制的向下 chip-flow（筹码流），第二步是借助 Cohn 定理完成的 0/1 多项式因式分解。也就是说，游戏的全部计算难度被完全隔离在最初那一步『数论意义上的分裂』上，其余部分都是高效可解的。为了把搜索空间压到可实验的规模，作者把两个因子的 popcount（汉明重量）作为 promise 提供给求解器——这一做法保持了问题的渐近难度，同时显著限制了可行的目标集合。随后，作者在这个受限空间中训练策略/价值网络，并配合 AlphaZero 风格的蒙特卡洛树搜索进行实验，实证性地考察神经前瞻（neural look-ahead）在『分解等价』环境中的能力边界。

论文的主要贡献在于：给出一个可复现、可实验的分解等价玩具问题，清晰拆解了该问题的难度来源（数论分裂 vs. 组合流动），并首次把学习型搜索与 MCTS 引入这一环境，为研究学习算法与数论难题之间的关系提供了新的实验平台。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 整数分解困难性是 RSA 等公钥密码的安全基石。该工作把分解包装成单人棋盘游戏并用 AlphaZero 式学习搜索求解，虽是玩具规模、远未威胁真实密钥，但为评估学习型搜索在数论难题上的能力上限提供了可复现的实验环境，值得密码学与 AI 安全方向长期跟踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 属于基础研究性质，短期不构成现实攻击面。可迁移场景包括：评估学习式搜索/启发式算法对分解类难题的实际增益，为后量子密码迁移的优先级讨论提供参考，以及作为测试『神经前瞻 + MCTS』在组合搜索环境中鲁棒性的基准。需注意当前实验依赖已知 popcount 的 promise 假设且规模为玩具级，对真实 RSA 参数长度不具备直接适用性。
defense_advice_zh: 将该论文作为研究线索纳入密码学风险的观察清单，而非即时威胁处置对象。
跟踪后续是否出现更大规模、取消 popcount promise 假设的实验结果，再评估其对现有 RSA 密钥长度的潜在影响。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Prefix Puncturable Signatures with Smaller Signing Key from HIBS
items.summary: Puncturable signatures, proposed by Bellare et al. (EUROCRYPT 2016), allow a signing key to be punctured (updated) so that it loses the ability to sign particular messages while retaining the ability to sign all others. Halevi et al. (ASIACRYPT 2017) introduced prefix puncturable signatures, in which the signing key can be punctured with respect to a target prefix so that it cannot sign messages whose prefixes match the target prefix. So far, several generic constructions of prefix puncturable signature schemes have been proposed, including constructions based on identity-based signatures (IBS) (ESORICS 2022) and delegated constrained signatures (IEEE Trans. Inf. Forensics Secure. 2024). However, these constructions suffer from drawbacks in terms of key size. When the prefix space is the set of all l-bit strings, the former construction requires a signing key consisting of 2^{l} IBS signing keys. The latter construction, when instantiated with a lattice-based delegated constrained signature scheme, yields a punctured signing key whose size grows quadratically with the number of puncturing operations Q^{Punc}. In this paper, we present a generic construction of prefix puncturable signatures from hierarchical identity-based signature (HIBS) schemes. When the prefix space is {0,1}^{l} and our construction is instantiated with the lattice-based HIBS scheme HIBS^{GPV} by Ruckert (PQC 2010), our construction achieves a punctured signing key size bounded by O(lQ^{Punc}).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究前缀可穿刺签名（prefix puncturable signatures）的密钥尺寸优化问题。可穿刺签名由 Bellare 等人在 EUROCRYPT 2016 提出，允许签名密钥被“穿刺”（更新），使其丧失对特定消息的签名能力，但保留对其他消息的签名能力。Halevi 等人在 ASIACRYPT 2017 进一步引入前缀可穿刺签名，签名的“穿刺”针对一个目标前缀，使得任何前缀与目标前缀匹配的消息都无法再被签名。此前已有若干通用构造，包括基于身份签名（IBS）的方案（ESORICS 2022）和基于委托约束签名（delegated constrained signatures）的方案（IEEE Trans. Inf. Forensics Secure. 2024）。然而，这些构造在密钥尺寸上存在明显缺陷：当前缀空间为全体 l 比特字符串时，前者需要由 2^l 个 IBS 签名密钥组成的签名密钥；后者在基于格的委托约束签名实例化下，穿刺后签名密钥大小随穿刺操作次数 Q^{Punc} 二次增长，即 O((Q^{Punc})^2) 量级。本文提出一种新的通用构造，将前缀可穿刺签名归约到分层身份基签名（HIBS）。核心思路是利用 HIBS 的层次化密钥派生特性，将前缀空间映射到身份层次结构，从而在穿刺时只需更新路径上的少量密钥而非枚举全部前缀。当前缀空间为 {0,1}^l，并使用 Ruckert 在 PQC 2010 提出的格基 HIBS 方案 HIBS^{GPV} 实例化时，该构造实现穿刺后签名密钥大小上界为 O(l Q^{Punc})，即随穿刺次数线性增长，显著优于先前的二次增长或指数级存储需求。论文给出了通用构造的形式化定义、安全证明，并在格基设置下分析了具体效率。主要贡献包括：首次建立 HIBS 与前缀可穿刺签名之间的通用联系；在标准格假设下获得更紧凑的穿刺密钥；为后量子安全场景下的密钥撤销和前向安全签名提供了更实用的候选方案。该工作适合密码学理论研究者、后量子密码工程师以及关注密钥管理机制的安全架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 前缀可穿刺签名可用于细粒度密钥撤销与前向安全，本文将穿刺密钥尺寸从二次增长降为 O(l Q^{Punc}) 线性增长，且支持基于格的实例化，直接提升后量子环境下此类方案的部署可行性，值得密码协议与密钥管理方向的安全从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至后量子 TLS、代码签名、基于属性的访问控制、密钥撤销列表压缩、以及需要前向安全或细粒度授权撤销的分布式系统。
defense_advice_zh: 关注后量子签名方案的密钥尺寸与撤销机制进展，评估其在内部密钥管理体系中的适用性
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in onSite internet GmbH Auktion NG Auktionssoftware up to 20260722. This affects an unknown part of the file /forgotpasswd.html of the component Public Password Reset Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument email leads to cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-96258 是 onSite internet GmbH 旗下拍卖软件产品 Auktion NG Auktionssoftware 中被披露的一个跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，影响版本范围为 up to 20260722（即截至 2026 年 7 月 22 日的版本）。漏洞位于组件“公开密码重置端点（Public Password Reset Endpoint）”所对应的文件 /forgotpasswd.html 中，具体受影响的功能模块尚不明确。问题根源在于该端点对参数 email 的输入未做充分的过滤或转义处理，攻击者可以通过构造特制的 email 参数值，使恶意脚本在受害者浏览器的上下文中执行，从而形成反射型 XSS。该漏洞可通过网络远程触发，无需攻击者持有账号或本地访问权限，但需要诱导受害者点击链接或访问被构造的请求，即存在用户交互前提。按照 CVSS 3.1 向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N 评估，基础评分为 4.3，属于中等严重性：机密性不受影响，完整性受到有限影响，可用性无影响。NVD 元数据明确记录该漏洞的利用细节已被公开披露，可能被他人使用；厂商在披露前被提前联系，但未作出任何回应。当前该 CVE 未被列入 CISA KEV 目录，也没有任何来源标注其已在野利用，因此应将其视为已公开细节但尚未确认遭实际攻击的漏洞。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致在受害者浏览器中执行任意脚本，可能窃取会话令牌或诱导用户提交敏感信息，破坏页面内容完整性。对系统本身无直接机密性与可用性影响，属中等风险，主要用于钓鱼与横向攻击链的前置环节。

items.title: Forward-reference completion for @JsonIdentityInfo object IDs in FasterXML jackson-databind performs a linear scan of the pending-reference accumulator for every resolved ID. Th...
items.summary: Forward-reference completion for @JsonIdentityInfo object IDs in FasterXML jackson-databind performs a linear scan of the pending-reference accumulator for every resolved ID. The affected paths are CollectionDeserializer.CollectionReferringAccumulator.resolveForwardReference() and the equivalent implementation in MapDeserializer. When a document first creates N unresolved object-ID references in an identity-enabled collection or map and then defines those same IDs in reverse order, completion performs on the order of N * (N + 1) / 2 identity comparisons, so a shallow document whose size grows linearly causes quadratic CPU work during deserialization. The reporter instrumented equals() calls on the ID class and measured exactly 2,003,000 comparisons at N = 2,000, against zero comparisons in the pending-reference lookup path for an equally sized control in which every reference was already resolved. The input requires no deep nesting and no syntactically unusual JSON. Exploitation requires an application that deserializes attacker-influenced JSON into an identity-enabled collection or map. The fix replaces the repeated linear lookup with a keyed pending-reference structure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 FasterXML jackson-databind 对 @JsonIdentityInfo 对象标识符的“前向引用补全”逻辑中。当反序列化一个启用对象身份（identity）的集合或映射时，若文档先建立 N 个尚未解析的对象 ID 引用，随后再以逆序把这些相同 ID 逐一给出定义，解析器每解析一个 ID 都要在“待解引用累加器”中做一次线性扫描以找到对应的占位引用。相关代码路径为 CollectionDeserializer.CollectionReferringAccumulator.resolveForwardReference() 以及 MapDeserializer 中的等价实现。由于扫描是逐个比对 ID 对象（调用 equals()），在逆序定义的情况下总体比较次数会达到 N*(N+1)/2 量级，即随输入规模线性增长却产生二次方（quadratic）的 CPU 开销，构成典型的算法复杂度型拒绝服务（DoS）。报告者通过对 ID 类插桩统计 equals() 调用次数进行验证：当 N = 2000 时精确观测到 2,003,000 次比较；而在规模相同、但所有引用在出现时即已解析完成的对照文档中，待解引用查找路径的比较次数为零，二者形成鲜明对比。触发条件并不苛刻：无需深层嵌套，也不需要语法上异常的 JSON，只需要目标应用把攻击者可控的 JSON 反序列化为启用了 identity 的集合或映射。官方修复方案是用基于键（keyed）的待解引用索引结构替换原有的重复线性查找，从而把补全阶段的开销从二次方降为与输入规模近似线性，从根本上消除该放大效应。按本条目给定的 CVSS 3.1 向量（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H）评分为 7.5，属于高危级别，但影响面仅限可用性，不涉及数据泄露或篡改。当前元数据未提供 EPSS 分值、受影响产品与厂商信息，且明确标注未列入 KEV、未见在野利用证据。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发后表现为反序列化阶段 CPU 时间被二次方放大，单请求即可长时间占用线程，导致服务响应变慢、线程池耗尽乃至拒绝服务。CVSS 3.1 评分 7.5（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H），影响仅限可用性，无保密性与完整性影响。利用前提是应用将攻击者可控 JSON 反序列化为启用对象身份的集合或映射。

items.title: TypeDeserializerBase._findDeserializer() in FasterXML jackson-databind caches the resolved deserializer under the raw, attacker-supplied type ID. When name-based polymorphism is...
items.summary: TypeDeserializerBase._findDeserializer() in FasterXML jackson-databind caches the resolved deserializer under the raw, attacker-supplied type ID. When name-based polymorphism is configured with a fallback, for example @JsonTypeInfo(use = Id.NAME, defaultImpl = ...), every distinct unrecognized type ID resolves to the same fallback deserializer but is retained as its own key in the _deserializers map. That map has no configurable bound and lives for the lifetime of the type deserializer, so an attacker who can repeatedly supply fresh unknown type IDs causes monotonic memory retention across requests. The reporter observed 10,000 retained entries from 10,000 distinct unknown IDs, against a single entry for a control that repeated one unknown ID the same number of times, isolating attacker-controlled key cardinality from request volume. Exploitation requires an application that enables name-based polymorphism with a defaultImpl or equivalent fallback, accepts attacker-influenced type IDs, and reuses a long-lived ObjectMapper across requests. The fix stops caching fallback resolutions for unrecognized IDs and bounds both the number of cached entries and the length of a cacheable type ID.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 FasterXML jackson-databind 的 TypeDeserializerBase._findDeserializer()。当应用启用基于名称的多态（@JsonTypeInfo(use = Id.NAME, ...)）并配置了回退实现（例如 defaultImpl 或等价机制）时，解析逻辑会把攻击者提交的“原始类型 ID”直接作为 key，将解析结果写入内部的 _deserializers 缓存 map。问题在于：所有未被识别的类型 ID 实际上都会回退到同一个 fallback 反序列化器，但每一个不同的未知 ID 仍会各自占用一个独立的缓存条目。该 map 没有可配置的容量上限，且生命周期与对应的 TypeDeserializer 实例一致，因此只要攻击者能够持续提交全新的、未曾出现过的未知类型 ID，缓存条目就会随请求单调增长，造成进程内存被长期占用并最终耗尽。报告者的实验数据清晰隔离了变量：提交 10,000 个互不相同的未知 ID 时，缓存中留下 10,000 条记录；而对照组在同样请求次数下重复使用同一个未知 ID，缓存中仅保留 1 条记录，说明增长源于攻击者可控的 key 基数，而非请求总量。成功利用需要同时满足三个条件：应用开启了带默认回退的基于名称多态；类型 ID 受攻击者影响（如来自请求体、消息队列或上游服务）；以及跨请求复用长生命周期的 ObjectMapper（这在 Web 服务中很常见）。官方修复停止对未识别 ID 的回退结果进行缓存，并对缓存条目数量和单个可缓存类型 ID 的长度同时施加边界限制。CVSS 3.1 评分 7.5，向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H，属纯可用性影响的远程拒绝服务。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 仅需发送大量互不相同的未知类型 ID 即可让共享 ObjectMapper 的缓存无界增长，最终 OOM 拖垮服务；利用门槛低（无需认证、无需用户交互），而受影响的多态回退配置在业务 JSON 接口中相当普遍，因此属于典型的低成本远程拒绝服务风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 内存被攻击者可控的缓存条目持续占用且不释放，导致进程堆内存膨胀、GC 压力升高，最终触发 OutOfMemoryError 或容器 OOM Kill，服务不可用。机密性与完整性不受影响，仅可用性受损(CVSS 7.5, A:H)。长期运行的网关、API 服务等复用 ObjectMapper 的场景受冲击最大。

items.title: UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken() in FasterXML jackson-core builds the offending-token text for its error message by appending Java identifier characters to a String...
items.summary: UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken() in FasterXML jackson-core builds the offending-token text for its error message by appending Java identifier characters to a StringBuilder in a loop that has no upper bound. Unlike the three sibling parser implementations, including UTF8StreamJsonParser, it never consults ErrorReportConfiguration.getMaxErrorTokenLength() (default 256). A malformed token supplied to a parser created through JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput) is therefore accumulated in full. No StreamReadConstraints setting mitigates this: maxDocumentLength cannot be applied to DataInput sources at all, and maxStringLength does not cover this path because the accumulation bypasses ReadConstrainedTextBuffer. The reporter measured a 20,000,109-character exception message from a 20-million-character malformed token on the DataInput path, against 367 characters for identical input on the InputStream path. Scaling the payload drives the StringBuilder, which also incurs byte-to-char expansion and internal array doubling, to many times the raw payload size and can trigger OutOfMemoryError for the whole JVM. UTF8DataInputJsonParser was introduced in 2.8.0 together with createParser(DataInput); releases before 2.8.0 do not contain the affected class.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-89425 是 FasterXML jackson-core 中一个仅影响可用性的拒绝服务类缺陷，根因位于 UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken()。该方法在构造 "非法 token" 错误消息时，会循环地把构成该 token 的 Java 标识符字符追加到一个 StringBuilder 中，而这个循环没有任何上界判断。与之同级的另外三个解析器实现（包括 UTF8StreamJsonParser）都会在追加前查询 ErrorReportConfiguration.getMaxErrorTokenLength()（默认 256 字符）来截断，唯独 DataInput 路径的实现遗漏了这一限制。因此，当解析器是通过 JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput) 创建、且输入为畸形 token 时，整个 token 会被完整地累积进内存。更棘手的是现有 StreamReadConstraints 机制无法缓解该问题：maxDocumentLength 根本无法应用于 DataInput 数据源，而 maxStringLength 也不覆盖这条路径，因为此处字符累积绕过了 ReadConstrainedTextBuffer。报告者给出的实测数据是：在 DataInput 路径上，2000 万字符的畸形 token 生成了长度约 20,000,109 字符的异常消息；而同样输入在 InputStream 路径上只产生 367 字符。攻击者只要不断放大畸形 token 规模，即可让 StringBuilder 连同其字节到字符的扩展和内部数组翻倍行为一起膨胀到远超原始载荷的体积，最终对整个 JVM 触发 OutOfMemoryError。受影响类 UTF8DataInputJsonParser 于 2.8.0 版本随 createParser(DataInput) 一同引入，2.8.0 之前的版本不包含该类。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 只要服务端把 DataInput（而非 InputStream）交给 jackson 解析不可信内容，一个超大畸形 token 即可让进程堆内存爆掉、整个 JVM 不可用；且现有 StreamReadConstraints 对此路径完全无效，等于缺少既有防护网。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功触发可导致解析线程乃至整个 JVM 抛出 OutOfMemoryError，造成服务不可用（CVSS 可用性影响为 High），不涉及机密性或完整性影响；攻击者无需认证、可远程通过网络提交畸形 JSON。

items.title: Ghidra before 12.1.4 fails to validate the TYPE_COL byte in OptionsDB.createUnregisteredOption(), causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException that leaves domain objects permanentl...
items.summary: Ghidra before 12.1.4 fails to validate the TYPE_COL byte in OptionsDB.createUnregisteredOption(), causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException that leaves domain objects permanently locked. Attackers can craft a malicious program database file that, when imported, causes the application to stall and prevents resource cleanup or graceful shutdown.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Ghidra 12.1.4 之前的版本在 OptionsDB.createUnregisteredOption() 中未对 TYPE_COL 字节做有效性校验。该字节本应作为内部类型处理器数组（type handler table）的下标使用，当被导入的程序数据库文件携带越界的 TYPE_COL 值时，会触发 ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException。异常发生在选项注册路径上，使 OptionsDB 持有的域对象（domain object）进入无法恢复的锁定状态：即使上层代码捕获了异常，该对象也不会被解锁或释放。最终表现为应用卡死（stall），后续的资源清理流程和正常关闭（graceful shutdown）均被阻塞。攻击模型为本地：攻击者需要构造一个特制的程序数据库文件，并诱使用户在 Ghidra 中导入该文件（UI:R），因此并非远程可利用。按 CVSS 3.1 评分 5.5（AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H），成功利用仅影响可用性，不造成信息泄露或数据篡改，但可能让分析人员丢失尚未保存的逆向工程成果并中断当前会话，同时长期占用工作站资源。修复方向是在 createUnregisteredOption() 中对 TYPE_COL 做范围校验并返回受控错误，而非抛出未处理异常，同时确保失败路径上锁与域对象能被正确释放。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 逆向分析经常要导入来源不可信的程序数据库文件，该缺陷可令 Ghidra 卡死并无法正常退出，造成分析成果丢失与资源占用。虽属本地利用且需用户交互，无保密性与完整性影响，但修复成本极低，应尽快升级至 12.1.4 及以上。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用性受损（CVSS 3.1 5.5，A:H）：导入特制程序数据库后 Ghidra 卡死，域对象被永久锁定，资源清理与优雅关闭失效，可能导致未保存的分析结果丢失；不涉及数据泄露或篡改。

items.summary: ReactPress is a publishing system for React developers. Prior to version 3.7.0, ReactPress API list endpoints build TypeORM `QueryBuilder` conditions using unsanitized HTTP query parameter names as SQL column identifiers (e.g. `` `article.${key}` ``). TypeORM parameterizes values but not column names, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject SQL through crafted query string keys. Version 3.7.0 contains a patch. As a workaround, allowlist allowed filter column names before interpolating into SQL.

items.title: A caching flaw in the toolbox-core package of the mcp-toolbox-sdk-python SDK causes the same Google ID token to be cached and reused across different audiences. If an applicatio...
items.summary: A caching flaw in the toolbox-core package of the mcp-toolbox-sdk-python SDK causes the same Google ID token to be cached and reused across different audiences. If an application uses the SDK to authenticate to two or more different audiences within the same process, the module-level token cache fails to key its cached tokens by the requested audience. Consequently, a valid, unexpired token minted for a sensitive service (Service A) can be retrieved from the cache and sent to a secondary service (Service B). An attacker who operates, compromises, or monitors traffic to Service B can capture this token and replay it to impersonate the victim application against Service A.

items.title: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability was identified in the notebook viewer of GitHub Enterprise Server. The notebook viewer validated the scheme and host of a user...
items.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability was identified in the notebook viewer of GitHub Enterprise Server. The notebook viewer validated the scheme and host of a user-supplied URL but did not validate the port, allowing requests to be directed to internal services listening on other ports of the same appliance. Response bodies were not returned to the requester, but response timing acted as an oracle that allowed instance secrets to be extracted character by character. An extracted secret could then be used in a separate interaction with an internal service to obtain remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required network access to the instance and was unauthenticated when private mode was disabled, or required any authenticated user when private mode was enabled. This vulnerability affected GitHub Enterprise Server versions 3.17 through 3.22 and was fixed in versions 3.22.1, 3.21.6, 3.20.8, 3.19.12, 3.18.15, and 3.17.21. This vulnerability was reported through the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated attacker to inject arbitrary HTML attributes into rend...
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated attacker to inject arbitrary HTML attributes into rendered Markdown because the Markdown rendering pipeline rewrote quote characters in already-sanitized HTML without re-sanitizing the result. Crafted Markdown could abuse same-origin JavaScript gadgets to bypass Content Security Policy and gain control of the page DOM when viewed by another user. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to read content visible to the victim, extract embedded CSRF tokens, perform state-changing actions as the victim, and exfiltrate data through same-origin writes. The payload could also propagate to repositories and organizations where the victim had write access. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.17, 3.18, 3.19, 3.20, 3.21, and 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.22.1, 3.21.6, 3.20.8, 3.19.12, 3.18.15, and 3.17.21. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

GET /api/admin/projects/:projectId/features/:featureName/environments/:environment/variants does not bind the requested feature to projectId, allowing cross-project variant configuration disclosure. GET .../strategies/:strategyId uses strategyId without validating the project and feature context, allowing cross-project strategy configuration disclosure. getEnvironmentInfo does not validate that the requested feature belongs to the supplied project, allowing cross-project environment information disclosure. PUT /:projectId/tags accepts feature identifiers without verifying that they belong to the URL project, allowing cross-project tag modification. This issue is fixed in version 8.0.3.

items.summary: Unleash is an open-source feature management platform. Prior to 8.0.3, POST /api/admin/projects/:projectId/features/:featureName/environments/:environment/strategies/set-sort-order passes attacker-controlled strategy IDs to unprotectedUpdateStrategiesSortOrder and updateSortOrder without verifying that the IDs belong to the project, feature, and environment authorized by the URL. In a multi-project Pro or Enterprise deployment, an authenticated user with UPDATE_FEATURE_STRATEGY in one project who knows another project's strategy IDs can reorder those strategies, changing feature evaluation precedence while the operation is attributed to the attacker's URL context rather than the affected project. The single-project OSS edition lacks the cross-project dimension, although the missing context binding still permits unauthorized reordering across features or environments in the default project. The endpoint changes only sort_order and does not modify strategy parameters, constraints, or segments. This issue is fixed in version 8.0.3.

items.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed any authenticated user of the instance to read the raw diff or patch of pull requests in private repositories without authorization. Access tokens for raw pull request diffs and patches were scoped to the repository name and pull request number rather than to a globally unique repository identifier, so an attacker who created a repository and pull request matching a target's repository name and pull request number could use a token for their own repository to retrieve the private pull request's contents. Exploitation required the attacker to know the target repository's name and a valid pull request number. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.22 and was fixed in versions 3.17.21, 3.18.15, 3.19.12, 3.20.8, and 3.21.6. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CMSimple 5.24 ships with CSRF protection disabled by default, which turns csrfProtection() into a no-op on every state-changing admin request, and it does not send the csrf_toke...
items.summary: CMSimple 5.24 ships with CSRF protection disabled by default, which turns csrfProtection() into a no-op on every state-changing admin request, and it does not send the csrf_token hidden field in admin forms. Because administrator authentication is cookie-only and no CSRF token is enforced, an unauthenticated attacker can induce a logged-in administrator's browser to issue a forged content-save request with a text payload containing a scripting marker. The marker is stored verbatim into content/content.php; on every subsequent page view evaluate_cmsimple_scripting() (functions.php) executes the marker body with PHP eval() — for all visitors, including unauthenticated ones. This yields persistent remote code execution on the web server.

items.summary: mppx is a TypeScript interface for machine payments protocol. Because EIP-2930 access-list entries consume intrinsic gas even when the listed addresses are never used, a client could add fabricated address-only entries and cause the server fee_payer wallet to pay unnecessary transaction fees. The demonstrated 180-entry list remained within the 500,000 gas policy cap, 16 KB header limit, and RPC simulation budget while increasing the fee by approximately 9.4 times. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.2.

items.summary: psd-tools is a Python package for working with Adobe Photoshop PSD files. Prior to 1.17.4, PSDImage.composite() and PSDImage.numpy() allocated output buffers from attacker-controlled PSD header geometry, including width, height, channels, depth, and per-layer rectangles, before validating those values against the available file data. items.summary:
Crypt::SelfCertificate versions from 1.01 through 1.05 for Perl contains malware which executes Python code from an obfuscated URL.

The generate_certificate runs a Python script saved as a certificate file.  The pyhton script attempts to retrieve code from a hardcoded http URL that is obfuscated with base64 encoding and run the response body directly.

The impact is that arbitrary code can be invoked as the user, without a dropped script being saved on the affected host.

The releases have no test scripts nor build hooks.  The intention may have been to trigger the payload after installation.

For version 1.01, the dropper script is in lib/Crypt/SelfCertificate/sample/validate.p12.

For version 1.05, the dropper script is in lib/Crypt/SelfCertificate/sample/cert7.pem.

The SHA-256 digests of the files are

An authenticated customer can derive reversible prefixed cart IDs, associate an eligible guest cart with the attacker's account, and receive billing and shipping address data from the cart. Exploitation requires a guest cart with address data on a store that does not require login for checkout, and reassignment can also disrupt the guest's in-progress cart. This issue is fixed in versions 5.4.4 and 5.5.4.

This issue is fixed in version 0.22.0.

items.title: js-toml is a TOML parser for JavaScript. Prior to 1.1.3, load() does not bound nesting or dotted-key depth in the recursive parser at src/load/parser.ts or the interpreter at sr...
items.summary: js-toml is a TOML parser for JavaScript. Prior to 1.1.3, load() does not bound nesting or dotted-key depth in the recursive parser at src/load/parser.ts or the interpreter at src/load/interpreter.ts, so deeply nested arrays, deeply nested inline tables, or long dotted keys can exhaust the V8 call stack and throw a raw RangeError instead of the documented SyntaxParseError. Applications that parse attacker-controlled TOML and handle only SyntaxParseError can rethrow the unexpected exception, which can terminate a worker or process and cause denial of service. The exception is synchronous and catchable by consumers that handle all exceptions, and the issue does not affect confidentiality or integrity. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.3.

items.summary: The Tauri updater plugin's 'check' IPC command accepts an allowDowngrades boolean parameter directly from frontend JavaScript code. When set to true, it replaces the version comparator from "update must be newer" to "update must be different." Because the default permission set grants allow-check to the webview, any XSS in the app frontend can invoke this command and bypass the only anti-rollback protection the updater offers. Combined with another bug, this enables downgrade attacks without even needing to fake a higher version number.

Prior to 8.9.8, the NPPM_SAVESESSION handler in PowerEditor/src/NppBigSwitch.cpp converts lParam to a sessionInfo pointer and dereferences its nbFile, files, and sessionFilePathName members without checking for null. A process running at the same or a higher Windows integrity level on the same desktop can send NPPM_SAVESESSION with a null lParam, immediately terminating Notepad++ and causing denial of service and loss of unsaved documents. This issue is fixed in version 8.9.8.

A sufficiently long settings directory causes the backup suffix to exceed the fixed stack buffer when Notepad++ saves the session, and the protected release build terminates through its stack canary, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 8.9.8.

This issue is fixed in version 8.9.8.

items.summary:
A stack-based buffer overflow in the dynamic loader (ld.so) of the GNU C Library (glibc) versions 2.14 through 2.44 allows a local attacker to crash or corrupt the memory of setuid/setgid (AT_SECURE) programs.

When such a program's DT_RPATH or DT_RUNPATH begins with $ORIGIN and is followed by NUL or '/' the loader both reads past the end of the path buffer and writes past the end of a stack-allocated internal buffer. The corrupted loader stack can lead to a loader crash (denial of service) and limited disclosure of process memory.

items.title: An HTTP endpoint intended for provisioning enterprise and reseller organisations is reachable without any session. The authentication middleware is bound only to an explicit lis...
items.summary:
An HTTP endpoint intended for provisioning enterprise and reseller organisations is reachable without any session. The authentication middleware is bound only to an explicit list of controllers, and the enterprise controller is not on that list, so no authentication runs for these routes.

The endpoint's only check is that the request body carries a token bearing a valid signature from the instance secret. It does not check what that token was issued for. Login tokens are signed with the same secret and carry no purpose, audience or expiry claim, so an ordinary user's own session token satisfies the check.

Presented with such a token, the endpoint creates a new organisation holding the highest subscription tier, flagged as lifetime and with a channel allowance far above any sold plan, creates an organisation-owner account alongside it, and returns the new organisation's API key in the response body. That key is immediately valid against the public API.

On a deployment with compatible NAT64 or DNS64 routing, _download and _build_guarded_opener accept the wrapper and fetch the internal resource, whose body is then ingested. Current interpreter behavior already blocks some RFC 8215 and 6to4 forms, but the fixed guard handles all documented wrappers without becoming more permissive than the standard library. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

This issue is fixed in version 2.10.4 and nightly build 2.10.0-782-nightly.

items.summary: Nuclei is a vulnerability scanner built on a simple YAML-based DSL. From 3.0.0 until 3.10.0, the DAST/fuzz payload path in pkg/fuzz/parts.go can evaluate substituted runtime data more than once, creating a second evaluation pass that allows response content captured by an internal: true extractor in one protocol step to be reinterpreted as template syntax in a later fuzz step. This vulnerability is an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-41645: the prior remediation made expressions.Evaluate() single-pass within one call but did not prevent DAST/fuzz callers from evaluating substituted output again. When -env-vars is enabled, a malicious scan target can return marker-shaped content that resolves against the template variable map and discloses scanner-host environment variables such as credentials, API keys, or tokens. The vulnerability requires a multi-step DAST or fuzz template, response data reused through an internal extractor, and explicit environment-variable expansion; users who do not enable -env-vars are not affected by the sensitive-information disclosure. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.0.

The phar stream wrapper causes PHP to treat a phar archive as a d...
items.summary:
MISP ships with PHP's phar stream wrapper registered in both its web entry point and its console entry point. 

The phar stream wrapper causes PHP to treat a phar archive as a directory, which has two security consequences:  

 - any filesystem operation on a caller-influenced path that resolves to a phar archive triggers an implicit unserialize() call, creating a deserialization sink;
 - a relocated application root can reach executable code inside an uploaded phar file, enabling arbitrary code execution as the web user.




No component of MISP, the vendored CakePHP framework, or any runtime-loaded library reads or constructs phar archives. The wrapper therefore serves no legitimate purpose in the MISP runtime and exists solely as an available primitive for an attacker who can influence a filesystem path argument.

items.title: A typo in the MISP ACLComponent access control configuration caused the ACL rule for the previewEventAttributes action to reference the permission string 'theming_enabled*' (wit...
items.summary:
A typo in the MISP ACLComponent access control configuration caused the ACL rule for the previewEventAttributes action to reference the permission string 'theming_enabled*' (with a trailing asterisk) instead of the correct 'theming_enabled'. In the MISP ACL system, the array values define which role or permission grants access to a given controller action. The adjacent entry previewEventObjects correctly uses ['theming_enabled'], confirming the intended restriction. The malformed key 'theming_enabled*' does not match any valid permission identifier, causing the access control check for previewEventAttributes to malfunction. Depending on the ACL evaluation logic, this could result in either unauthorized users gaining access to the previewEventAttributes endpoint (authorization bypass) or legitimate users being denied access (availability impact). 

The previewEventAttributes endpoint exposes event attribute data within MISP so an authorization bypass could expose sensitive indicator and attribute data to users who should not have access.

items.summary: A flaw was found in SSSD. When configured with the LDAP access provider and `ldap_access_order` including `ppolicy` or `lockout`, a fail-open condition in the LDAP ppolicy access check can occur if a user lookup returns zero results. This can incorrectly return success and cache an allow decision, permitting continued authorization for a deleted or deprovisioned user. A remote attacker with prior valid account context could exploit this to maintain access to information and potentially make limited modifications to resources that should no longer be available.

items.title: Traefik is an open source HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer. From 3.6.11 until 3.7.13, checkPassword in pkg/middlewares/auth/basic_auth.go constructs the BasicAuth singleflig...
items.summary: Traefik is an open source HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer. From 3.6.11 until 3.7.13, checkPassword in pkg/middlewares/auth/basic_auth.go constructs the BasicAuth singleflight key from the submitted password and stored secret. Concurrent requests for absent usernames therefore coalesce on one key while configured usernames perform separate password hashes, creating an unauthenticated timing discrepancy that reveals whether a username exists. Sequential checks remain cost-equalized, Traefik v2 and Digest authentication are not affected, and the issue does not disclose credentials or bypass authentication. This issue is fixed in version 3.7.13.

items.title: A time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the dynamic loader (ld.so) of the GNU C Library (glibc) versions 2.14 through 2.44 allows a local attacker to escalate ...
items.summary:
A time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the dynamic loader (ld.so) of the GNU C Library (glibc) versions 2.14 through 2.44 allows a local attacker to escalate privileges. When expanding $ORIGIN in DT_RPATH for setuid/setgid (AT_SECURE) programs, glibc validates the lexically normalized search path against the trusted directories but then opens the raw, un-normalized path. On systems where the Linux fs.protected_hardlinks sysctl is disabled, a local attacker who hard-links such a program into an attacker-controlled directory and wins a race to replace an intermediate path component with a symbolic link can direct the loader outside the trusted directory, causing it to load an attacker-controlled shared object and execute arbitrary code with the elevated privileges of the program.

Exploitation requires an installed setuid or setgid binary whose DT_RPATH uses $ORIGIN followed by ".." traversal that normalizes into a trusted directory, and the ability to hard-link that binary and win the race by swapping a path component for a symbolic link. Major Linux-based OS distributions ship with fs.protected_hardlinks enabled by default and mitigate the vulnerability.

items.title: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in OAuth token issuance in hexpm hexpm allows a user whose organization membership or session has ended to keep reading the organiz...
items.summary:
Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in OAuth token issuance in hexpm hexpm allows a user whose organization membership or session has ended to keep reading the organization's private packages and their documentation tarballs via a retained refresh token.

generate_refresh_token/4 in lib/hexpm/oauth/jwt.ex signs the refresh token with the same iss, aud and scope claims as the access token, so it carries the same repository:<org> scopes. The CDN service that serves private repositories verifies the signature and time claims and then authorizes from the scope claim, with no database lookup and no way to tell the two token kinds apart. Removing a member or revoking a session therefore takes effect at the CDN only when the 30 day refresh token expires, instead of after the 30 minute access token lifetime. Access is read-only and limited to organizations the account belonged to when the token was granted.

This issue affects hex.pm: from 2025-10-10 before 2026-09-22.

items.summary: Twenty is an open-source CRM (customer relationship management) platform. Prior to 2.22.0, field-level read permission is enforced on selected output fields but not on GraphQL or REST filter predicates. A workspace member or API key with permission to read an object but not a particular field can reference that denied field in direct filters, relation filters, or persisted view filters. The resulting totalCount and row presence reveal whether guesses match the real column, forming a boolean/count oracle that can reconstruct denied field values for records exposed by the principal's row-level policy. This issue is fixed in version 2.22.0.

items.summary: radare2 is a UNIX-like reverse engineering framework and command-line toolset. Prior to 6.2.0, radare2's Windows 64-bit crash-dump dmp64 parser was vulnerable because the Windows dmp64 parser used an input-controlled physical-memory-run PageCount directly as the bound of a per-page allocation loop. The vulnerability is triggered by opening a small crafted full-memory Windows crash dump. The parser repeatedly allocated and appended page descriptors without validating the count against the dump size. This can cause denial of service through excessive memory consumption and processing time. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.0.

items.summary: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management and sharing system. Prior to 4.18.0, PrepareUpload in pkg/filemanager/fs/dbfs/upload.go checks a stale in-memory user storage value through validateUserCapacity and later applies an unconditional storage charge outside the same quota-enforcing transaction. An authenticated user with Files.Write permission can issue concurrent upload-session requests that read the same capacity snapshot, all pass the MaxStorage check, and reserve their declared sizes through CommitWithStorageDiff. The resulting reservations can exceed the account quota and can be materialized as chunked uploads that exhaust host storage and deny uploads to other users. The default local-storage policy and default User group are affected. This issue is fixed in version 4.18.0.

items.summary: Vector is a high-performance observability data pipeline. From 0.10.0 until 0.57.0, the file sink renders its templated path from event fields and opens the result without confining it to an intended directory. When an untrusted source supplies an event field used by the path template, the value can contain an absolute path or parent-directory traversal, causing Vector to create parent directories and create or overwrite files outside the intended location with the Vector process privileges. The resulting file write can modify sensitive files and can lead to code execution when a scheduled task, authorization file, or subsequently executed script is targeted. This issue is fixed in version 0.57.0.

items.summary: Novu provides an API for sending notifications through multiple channels. Prior to 3.18.0, Novu integration mutation use cases including remove-integration, update-integration, auto-configure-integration, and set-integration-as-primary look up an integration by integrationId and organizationId without consistently enforcing environmentId. A caller with access to one environment in an organization can target an integration identifier from another environment and delete the integration, modify its credentials, change the primary provider, or trigger auto-configuration. The repository advisory defines both environment API keys and dashboard sessions as affected. The 3.18.0 change enforces the environment boundary only for environment-scoped API-key authentication, while its tests intentionally retain cross-environment dashboard-session behavior, so it does not completely remediate the advisory-defined scope. Version 3.18.0 is a partial fix attempt, and the dashboard-session behavior requires curator resolution.
